**Direct Summary (EN)**: Qualcomm Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme (80 TOPS Hexagon NPU · 18-core Oryon) and Intel Core Ultra Series 3 "Panther Lake" (50 TOPS NPU 5 · Arc B390 12 Xe3 cores on Intel 18A) dominate 2026 thin-and-light Windows AI laptops. For local LLMs, ignore the NPU TOPS sticker: standard llama.cpp and Ollama run on the integrated GPU, where X2 Elite Extreme’s 192-bit LPDDR5X-9533 bus (228 GB/s, up to 128GB) beats Panther Lake’s 128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 (153.6 GB/s, up to 64/96GB) by ~48% on token decode—while Intel’s XMX matrix engines fight back on prompt prefill and x86_64 compatibility.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 高通骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme（80 TOPS Hexagon NPU · 18 核 Oryon）与 Intel 18A 工艺的酷睿 Ultra 300 系列「Panther Lake」（50 TOPS NPU 5 · Arc B390 12 核 Xe3）是 2026 年 Windows 轻薄 AI 笔记本的两大旗舰。跑本地大模型时请先忽略 NPU TOPS 贴纸：标准 llama.cpp 与 Ollama 运行在核显与统一内存之上，X2 Elite Extreme 独享的 192-bit LPDDR5X-9533 总线（228 GB/s，最高 128GB）在生成速度上限上比 Panther Lake 的 128-bit LPDDR5X-9600（153.6 GB/s，最高 64/96GB）快约 48%，而 Intel 凭借 XMX 矩阵引擎在预填充与 x86_64 软件生态上扳回一城。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- Evidence level: SPEC-DERIVED ESTIMATE. Decode tok/s figures in Table 2 are computed from published memory bandwidth (bandwidth × 0.68 ÷ active-weight bytes per token) and have not yet been measured on retail laptops in our lab.
- Crucial SKU trap on Qualcomm: ONLY the top-bin **Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme (`X2E-96-100`)** has the **192-bit memory bus (228 GB/s)**. Standard `Snapdragon X2 Elite` (`X2E-94-100` / `X2E-90-100`) drops to a **128-bit bus (~152 GB/s)**—matching Panther Lake’s bandwidth.
- Neither the 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU nor the 50 TOPS Intel NPU 5 is used by standard `llama.cpp` or `Ollama` out of the box. Running models on the NPU requires `OpenVINO GenAI` (Intel) or `Qualcomm QNN / Genie / Nexa SDK` (Snapdragon) with static INT4 compilation and typically caps out at 3B–8B dense models.
- [ZH] 证据等级：规格推算估算。表 2 中的生成速度 tok/s 均按公开内存带宽（带宽 × 0.68 ÷ 每 token 激活权重字节数）推算，尚未在本站实验室零售样机上实测。
- [ZH] 高通型号天坑：只有顶配 **骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme（`X2E-96-100`）** 才配备 **192-bit 内存位宽（228 GB/s）**！标准版 `骁龙 X2 Elite`（`X2E-94-100` / `X2E-90-100`）缩水为 **128-bit 位宽（约 152 GB/s）**，与 Panther Lake 处于同一水平。
- [ZH] 无论是 80 TOPS 的高通 Hexagon NPU 还是 50 TOPS 的 Intel NPU 5，默认的 `llama.cpp` 与 `Ollama` 均不会调用它们。若想调用 NPU 省电推理，必须使用专用编译格式（Intel `OpenVINO GenAI` 或高通 `QNN / Genie`），且通常仅适合 3B–8B 稠密小模型。

#### 1. The 192-bit vs 128-bit Bus Divide & Why 80 TOPS NPU != Fast llama.cpp / 1. 192-bit 与 128-bit 位宽分水岭：为什么 80 TOPS NPU 不等于 llama.cpp 跑得快？
When shopping for a sub-1.5 kg laptop to run local LLMs in late 2026, spec sheets will shout **"80 TOPS NPU"** (Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme) vs **"50 TOPS NPU + 180 Platform TOPS"** (Intel Core Ultra X9 388H "Panther Lake"). Here is the engineering reality: **1) Standard GGUF tools (`llama.cpp`, `Ollama`, `LM Studio` default engines) run on the integrated GPU and CPU, not the NPU.** Using the NPU requires pre-quantized INT4 graphs via `OpenVINO` (Intel) or `QNN` (Qualcomm), which are awesome for running a background 3B–8B assistant at 6W of battery power, but cannot flexibly load a 30B-A3B or 80B-A3B GGUF with 32K context. **2) On the GPU/UMA path, memory bus width rules:** Qualcomm gave the top-bin **`X2E-96-100` (Extreme)** a **192-bit LPDDR5X-9533 interface (`228 GB/s`, up to 128GB RAM)**, whereas non-Extreme X2 chips (`X2E-94/90`) and Intel’s **Core Ultra X9 388H** use a **128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 interface (`153.6 GB/s`, typically 32GB–64GB, up to 96GB)**. Conversely, Intel’s integrated **Arc B390 GPU (12 Xe3 cores)** includes dedicated hardware **XMX systolic matrix engines** with mature `SYCL` and `Vulkan` backends—giving Panther Lake an edge on compute-heavy prompt prefill and zero x86 emulation headaches.
在选购 2026 款轻薄本跑本地大模型时，厂商宣传页最醒目的永远是 **「80 TOPS NPU」**（骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme）对决 **「50 TOPS NPU + 180 平台总 TOPS」**（Intel 酷睿 Ultra X9 388H「Panther Lake」）。但落到工程实操上，有两条铁律必须看清：**第一，标准的 GGUF 工具链（`llama.cpp`、`Ollama`）默认跑在核显（iGPU）与 CPU 上，根本不走 NPU。** 想要调用 NPU 必须通过 Intel `OpenVINO GenAI` 或高通 `QNN / Genie` 加载专门转换的 INT4 静态图——这非常适合在断电续航时以 5–7W 超低功耗后台常驻 3B–8B 小助手，但无法灵活加载 30B/80B MoE GGUF 及 32K 长上下文。**第二，在核显统一内存路径下，内存位宽决定生死：** 高通仅为最顶配的 **`X2E-96-100`（Extreme 版）** 开放了 **192-bit LPDDR5X-9533 总线（`228 GB/s`，最高支持 128GB 内存）**，比次顶配 X2 Elite（128-bit · 152 GB/s）和 Intel **酷睿 Ultra X9 388H**（128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 · `153.6 GB/s`，主流 32GB–64GB）高出约 **48% 的内存带宽**！反过来，Intel 集成的 **Arc B390 核显（12 核 Xe3 架构）** 拥有硬件级 **XMX 脉动矩阵引擎** 与成熟的 `SYCL` / `Vulkan` 算子，在长提示词预填充（Prefill）和 x86_64 原生兼容性上明显占优。

**Table 1: Architectural comparison for local LLM execution (Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme vs Standard X2 Elite vs Intel Panther Lake 388H) / 表 1：轻薄本本地大模型核心架构对比（骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme vs 标准版 X2 Elite vs Intel Panther Lake 388H）**
| Architecture Spec (核心架构指标) | Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme (`X2E-96-100`) (骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme (`X2E-96-100`)) | Snapdragon X2 Elite (`X2E-94/90`) (骁龙 X2 Elite 标准版 (`X2E-94/90`)) | Intel Core Ultra X9 388H ("Panther Lake") (Intel 酷睿 Ultra X9 388H (Panther Lake)) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Process & CPU Cores / 制程与 CPU 核心 | TSMC 3nm · 18C 3rd-Gen Oryon (ARM64) / 台积电 3nm · 18 核三代 Oryon (ARM64) | TSMC 3nm · 12C 3rd-Gen Oryon (ARM64) / 台积电 3nm · 12 核三代 Oryon (ARM64) | Intel 18A · 16C (4P + 8E + 4LPE, x86_64) / Intel 18A · 16 核 (4P + 8E + 4LPE, x86_64) |
| Memory Bus & Bandwidth / 内存位宽与带宽 | **192-bit** LPDDR5X-9533 · **228 GB/s** / **192-bit** LPDDR5X-9533 · **228 GB/s** | 128-bit LPDDR5X-9533 · ~152 GB/s / 128-bit LPDDR5X-9533 · 约 152 GB/s | 128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 · **153.6 GB/s** / 128-bit LPDDR5X-9600 · **153.6 GB/s** |
| Max Unified RAM / 最大统一内存容量 | Up to **128 GB** (on-package) / 最高 **128 GB**（封装内存） | Up to 64 GB / 最高 64 GB | Up to **64 GB / 96 GB** (LPDDR5X / LPCAMM2) / 最高 **64 GB / 96 GB** |
| Integrated GPU & Matrix Units / 集成核显与矩阵单元 | Adreno X2-90 (Vulkan / OpenCL) / Adreno X2-90 (Vulkan / OpenCL) | Adreno X2-85 (Vulkan / OpenCL) / Adreno X2-85 (Vulkan / OpenCL) | **Intel Arc B390 (12 Xe3 Cores + XMX)** / **Intel Arc B390 (12 核 Xe3 + XMX 矩阵引擎)** |
| Dedicated NPU & SDK / 独立 NPU 与专用运行时 | 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU (`QNN` / `Genie`) / 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU (`QNN` / `Genie`) | 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU (`QNN` / `Genie`) / 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU (`QNN` / `Genie`) | 50 TOPS NPU 5 (`OpenVINO GenAI` / `IPEX`) / 50 TOPS NPU 5 (`OpenVINO GenAI` / `IPEX`) |

#### 2. Estimated Decode Ceilings & Model Sizing Across 64GB vs 128GB Thin-and-Light Configs / 2. 64GB 与 128GB 轻薄本模型装载边界与生成速度估算（非实测）
Using our standard bandwidth formula (`ceiling = bandwidth ÷ active_bytes`, `expected ≈ ceiling × 0.68` at ≤8K context with `Q8_0` KV cache), Table 2 shows what each chip can realistically run. Because **Qwen3-30B-A3B (`~18.6 GB` total, `~2.0 GB` active per token)** only streams 2 GB of weights per token, both chips run it remarkably fast (`~52 tok/s` estimated on Panther Lake 388H; `~77 tok/s` estimated on Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme)—making 32GB/64GB laptops with either chip phenomenal portable coding machines. And if you manage to buy a **128GB Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme** SKU, it can even hold **Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (`~48 GB` Q4_K_M, `~1.8 GB` active)** entirely in unified memory.
按照本站统一的带宽推算公式（`理论上限 = 带宽 ÷ 每 token 激活字节数`，`预期速度 ≈ 理论上限 × 0.68`，基于 ≤8K 上下文与 `Q8_0` KV Cache），表 2 给出了两款轻薄本平台在各量级模型下的预期表现。由于 **Qwen3-30B-A3B（总权重约 `18.6 GB`，单 token 仅激活读取约 `2.0 GB`）** 每生成一个词元只需搬运 2 GB 权重，两款芯片在 32GB/64GB 配置下都能跑出极为流畅的速度（Panther Lake 388H 估算约 `52 tok/s`，骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme 估算约 `77 tok/s`）。而如果你买到了顶配 **128GB 内存的骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme**，甚至能在轻薄本里完整装下 **Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B（`Q4_K_M` 约 48 GB）**。

**Table 2: ESTIMATED decode tok/s on GPU/UMA (GGUF Q4_K_M, ≤8K context, Q8_0 KV). Not lab-measured; replace with your run of the script below. / 表 2：核显统一内存路径下的生成速度估算（GGUF Q4_K_M，≤8K 上下文，Q8_0 KV）。非实测，请用下方脚本实测替换。**
| Model (GGUF Q4_K_M) (测试模型 (GGUF Q4_K_M)) | Weights / Active per Token (总权重 / 单 Token 激活量) | X2 Elite Extreme 128GB (228 GB/s) (骁龙 X2 Elite Extreme 128GB (228 GB/s)) | Core Ultra X9 388H 64GB (153.6 GB/s) (酷睿 Ultra X9 388H 64GB (153.6 GB/s)) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Qwen3-8B (Dense) / Qwen3-8B（稠密） | ~5.0 GB / ~5.0 GB / 约 5.0 GB / 约 5.0 GB | fits · ceiling ~45 · expected **~31 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 45 · 预期 **约 31 tok/s** | fits · ceiling ~31 · expected **~21 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 31 · 预期 **约 21 tok/s** |
| Qwen3-14B (Dense) / Qwen3-14B（稠密） | ~9.0 GB / ~9.0 GB / 约 9.0 GB / 约 9.0 GB | fits · ceiling ~25 · expected **~17 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 25 · 预期 **约 17 tok/s** | fits · ceiling ~17 · expected **~11.6 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 17 · 预期 **约 11.6 tok/s** |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B (MoE, 3.3B active) / Qwen3-30B-A3B（MoE，3.3B 激活） | ~18.6 GB / ~2.0 GB / 约 18.6 GB / 约 2.0 GB | fits · ceiling ~114 · expected **~77 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 114 · 预期 **约 77 tok/s** | fits (32GB+) · ceiling ~77 · expected **~52 tok/s** / 可装下 (32GB+) · 上限约 77 · 预期 **约 52 tok/s** |
| Qwen3-32B (Dense) / Qwen3-32B（稠密） | ~19.8 GB / ~19.8 GB / 约 19.8 GB / 约 19.8 GB | fits · ceiling ~11.5 · expected **~7.8 tok/s** / 可装下 · 上限约 11.5 · 预期 **约 7.8 tok/s** | fits (32GB+) · ceiling ~7.8 · expected **~5.3 tok/s** / 可装下 (32GB+) · 上限约 7.8 · 预期 **约 5.3 tok/s** |
| Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (MoE, 3B active) / Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B（MoE，3B 激活） | ~48.2 GB / ~1.8 GB / 约 48.2 GB / 约 1.8 GB | fits on 128GB · ceiling ~126 · expected **~85 tok/s*** / 128GB 可装下 · 上限约 126 · 预期 **约 85 tok/s*** | tight on 64GB (needs 52GB+ GTT) · **~58 tok/s*** / 64GB 处于临界（需调高共享显存）· **约 58 tok/s*** |

#### 3. Reproduction Protocol: Verify Bus Width, Active iGPU Backend & 10-Minute Laptop Throttle / 3. 复现协议：核验真实位宽、核显后端与 10 分钟轻薄本热降频测试
Because fanless or single-fan 14-inch laptops often throttle memory controller clocks after 3–5 minutes of sustained LLM generation, a single 10-second `llama-bench` run can overstate real throughput by 25%+. Run the protocol below (or download the embedded `bench-panther-lake-x2-elite-llm.sh` artifact) to verify native binary architecture, list active Vulkan/SYCL devices, and compare burst vs 10-minute sustained decode speed.
由于 14 英寸轻薄本在持续满载 3–5 分钟后极易因散热触顶而降低内存控制器与核显频率，仅跑 10 秒的短平快测试往往会虚高 25% 以上。请执行下方复现指令（或下载内嵌脚本 `bench-panther-lake-x2-elite-llm.sh`），一次性核验原生架构、枚举 Vulkan/SYCL 设备并对比第 1 分钟与第 10 分钟的持续生成速度。
```bash
# 1) Verify native binary architecture (must be ARM64 on X2 Elite, x86_64 on Panther Lake)
uname -m
./build/bin/llama-bench --list-devices

# 2) Run fixed 3-rep benchmark with Flash Attention & Q8_0 KV Cache
./build/bin/llama-bench -m Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 -fa 1 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -p 2048 -n 128 -r 3 -o md

# 3) Optional on Snapdragon X2: compare Vulkan GPU (-ngl 99) vs 18-core Oryon ARM64 CPU (-ngl 0 -t 16)
./build/bin/llama-bench -m Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf -ngl 0 -t 16 -p 512 -n 128 -r 3 -o md
```

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: When SHOULD I actually use the 80 TOPS Hexagon NPU or 50 TOPS Intel NPU 5 for local LLMs? / 到底什么场景下才应该真正动用 80 TOPS 的高通 NPU 或 50 TOPS 的 Intel NPU 5？
  **A**: Use the NPU when **unplugged battery life and zero fan noise** matter more than model size: running a `3B–8B INT4` model (such as `Llama-3.2-3B` or `Qwen3-8B`) via `OpenVINO GenAI` (on Intel NPU 5) or `Qualcomm Genie / Nexa SDK` (on Hexagon NPU) draws only **4.5W–7W**, cutting total laptop power draw roughly in half compared to saturating the GPU and memory controller. (当你处于**离电移动办公、追求极致续航与风扇零噪音**，且只需要运行 `3B–8B INT4` 轻量模型（如 `Llama-3.2-3B`、`Qwen3-8B`）做文档摘要或翻译时，通过 `OpenVINO GenAI`（Intel NPU 5）或高通 `QNN / Genie` 调用 NPU 仅消耗 **4.5W–7W** 功耗，比跑满核显省电约一半！但若要跑 `30B-A3B MoE` 写代码，则必须走核显/CPU 统一内存路径。)
- **Q**: Between a 64GB Intel Core Ultra X9 388H laptop and a 64GB standard Snapdragon X2 Elite (non-Extreme), which is better for local AI? / 如果同样是 64GB 内存，在 Intel 酷睿 Ultra X9 388H 与“非 Extreme”标准版骁龙 X2 Elite 之间该选谁？
  **A**: Pick the **Intel Core Ultra X9 388H ("Panther Lake")**. Once you step down from the 192-bit `X2 Elite Extreme` to the 128-bit standard `X2 Elite`, both laptops have essentially identical ~152–154 GB/s memory bandwidth, but Intel gives you **12 Xe3 cores with hardware XMX matrix acceleration**, mature `SYCL`/`Vulkan`/`OpenVINO` Linux & Windows drivers, and full native x86_64 Docker/Python compatibility. (毫不犹豫选 **Intel 酷睿 Ultra X9 388H（Panther Lake）**！因为一旦脱离了 192-bit 的 `X2 Elite Extreme` 顶配，标准版 X2 Elite 的位宽同样只有 128-bit（约 152 GB/s），此时两者内存带宽打平，但 Intel 拥有带 **XMX 硬件矩阵单元的 12 核 Xe3 核显**、更成熟的 Linux/Windows 驱动，以及零仿真损耗的 x86_64 原生开发环境。)

## Running 30B & 80B MoE Models on a 12GB–24GB Consumer GPU + Dual-Channel DDR5 PC: Native llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe Benchmark & RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB) / 5080 SUPER (24GB) Sizing
### 单张 12GB–24GB 消费级显卡 + 双通道 DDR5 跑通 30B 与 80B MoE 大模型：llama.cpp 原生 --n-cpu-moe 专家卸载实测与 RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB) / 5080 SUPER (24GB) 显存选型

- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/guides/llama-cpp-n-cpu-moe-hybrid-offload-16gb-24gb-vram-ddr5-vs-rtx-5080-super-24gb-5070-super-18gb/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/guides/llama-cpp-n-cpu-moe-hybrid-offload-16gb-24gb-vram-ddr5-vs-rtx-5080-super-24gb-5070-super-18gb/
- **Pillar**: Local AI / HomeLab / 本地 AI / HomeLab
- **Tested Hardware (EN)**: Measured on: AMD Ryzen 9 9900X + 64GB Dual-Channel DDR5-6400 CL30 (~84 GB/s read) + NVIDIA RTX 4070 (12GB) / RTX 5060 Ti (16GB) / RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) / RTX 4090 (24GB) | Spec-estimate rows: NVIDIA RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB GDDR7 192-bit · ~672 GB/s) & RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB GDDR7 256-bit 32 Gbps · ~1,024 GB/s)
- **Tested Hardware (ZH)**: 实测平台：AMD Ryzen 9 9900X + 64GB 双通道 DDR5-6400 CL30（实测读取 ~84 GB/s）+ RTX 4070 (12GB) / RTX 5060 Ti (16GB) / RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) / RTX 4090 (24GB) | 规格推算对照：NVIDIA RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB GDDR7 192-bit · ~672 GB/s) 与 RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB GDDR7 256-bit 32 Gbps · ~1,024 GB/s)
- **Pinned Versions**: llama.cpp b4920+ (upstream native `--n-cpu-moe` / `-ncmoe` & `--cpu-moe` / `-cmoe` support), CUDA 12.8 (`GGML_CUDA=1` + Flash Attention `-fa`), Models: Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf (18.6 GB, 48 layers) & Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf (48.2 GB, 48 layers)
- **Verified Date**: 2026-11-06
- **Offline Boundary**: 100% Local Desktop GPU + DDR5 Execution — All GGUF weights and `--n-cpu-moe` tensor splits run locally across PCIe and system RAM with zero external API calls.

**Direct Summary (EN)**: You do not need an EPYC server or a $4,000 workstation card to run Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6GB) or Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2GB) on a desktop PC. Upstream llama.cpp’s native `--n-cpu-moe N` (`-ncmoe N`) flag keeps 100% of attention layers and the Q8_0 KV cache inside your 12GB/16GB/24GB GPU while offloading only sparse MoE experts for N layers to dual-channel DDR5 RAM—delivering 46–55 tok/s on Qwen3-30B-A3B and 26–33 tok/s on Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B. We also model how 3GB-module GDDR7 refreshes (RTX 5070 SUPER 18GB & RTX 5080 SUPER 24GB, spec-estimate) shift the exact `--n-cpu-moe` threshold.
**核心结论 (ZH)**: 无需昂贵的 EPYC 服务器或万元工作站卡，普通家用台式机（单张 12GB/16GB/24GB 独显 + 64GB 双通道 DDR5 内存）现在就能流畅跑通 Qwen3-30B-A3B（18.6GB）与 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B（48.2GB）！借助主线 llama.cpp 原生支持的 `--n-cpu-moe N`（简写 `-ncmoe N`）参数，可将 100% 注意力层与 KV Cache 焊死在 GDDR6/GDDR7 显存内，仅把前 N 层的稀疏专家卸载至双通道 DDR5，在 16GB 显卡上实测跑出 46–55 tok/s（30B-A3B）与 26.4 tok/s（80B-A3B）。本文同时按单颗 3GB GDDR7 颗粒规格推算了 RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB) 与 RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB) 对卸载层数的改变。

**Known Limits & Failure Boundaries**:
- The RTX 4070 (12GB), RTX 5060 Ti (16GB), RTX 5070 Ti (16GB), and RTX 4090 (24GB) rows in Table 1 are lab-measured on our Ryzen 9 9900X + DDR5-6400 testbench; the **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB)** and **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB)** rows are **SPEC-DERIVED ESTIMATES** based on leaked 3GB (24Gb) GDDR7 module specs and are explicitly labeled `[Spec-Est.]`.
- `--n-cpu-moe N` only helps **sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** models (`Qwen3-30B-A3B`, `Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B`, `DeepSeek-V3/R1`). On dense models (`Qwen3-32B`, `Llama-3.3-70B`), every parameter is active on every token, so offloading to dual-channel DDR5 (~84 GB/s) still drops decode speed into single digits.
- [ZH] 表 1 中 RTX 4070 (12GB)、RTX 5060 Ti (16GB)、RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) 与 RTX 4090 (24GB) 为本站 Ryzen 9 9900X + DDR5-6400 平台实测数据；而 **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB)** 与 **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB)** 两行为基于单颗 3GB (24Gb) GDDR7 显存规格的**理论推算值**，在表中已明确标注 `[规格推算]`。
- [ZH] `--n-cpu-moe N` 仅对**稀疏混合专家模型（MoE）**有奇效（因为单 Token 仅激活约 3B 专家权重）。对于稠密模型（如 `Qwen3-32B`、`Llama-3.3-70B`），一旦溢出到双通道 DDR5（~84 GB/s），生成速度依然会跌至个位数。

#### 1. Why Upstream `llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe N` Beats Classic Layer Splitting (`-ngl`) by 3.4x / 1. 为什么主线 `llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe N` 比传统按层切分 (`-ngl`) 快 3.4 倍？
Suppose you have a mainstream **16GB GPU (`RTX 5060 Ti` / `5070 Ti` / `4080`)** and want to run **`Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M` (`18.6 GB` weights + `~1.8 GB` KV cache at 32K context = `~21 GB` total)**. With traditional layer offloading (`-ngl 33`), `llama.cpp` pushes layers `0–32` onto the GPU and leaves layers `33–47` **completely on the CPU**—forcing both the heavy multi-head attention + KV cache reads and the MoE routers of those 15 layers onto slow CPU threads (`16.1 tok/s`). In contrast, when you pass **`-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16`** (`-ncmoe 16`), upstream `llama.cpp` keeps **all 48 layers of Dense Attention, KV Cache, and Shared Tensors 100% inside GDDR7 VRAM**, and only moves the **routed MoE expert FFN tensors (`ffn_*_exps.weight`) of the first 16 layers into dual-channel DDR5 RAM**. Because `Qwen3-30B-A3B` only activates **3.3B parameters (~2.0 GB total across all 48 layers)** per token, offloading 16 layers of experts means the CPU only reads **~0.67 GB from DDR5 per token**—skyrocketing decode speed from `16.1 tok/s` to **`54.6 tok/s`** while keeping prefill at **`3,180 tok/s`**!
假设你手里有一张主流的 **16GB 显卡（`RTX 5060 Ti` / `5070 Ti` / `4080`）**，想运行综合能力极强的 **`Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M`（权重 `18.6 GB` + 32K 上下文 KV Cache 约 `1.8 GB` = 总计约 `21 GB`）**。如果用传统的按层切分（`-ngl 33`），`llama.cpp` 会把后 15 层的**注意力层（Attention）、KV Cache 和专家层全部扔给 CPU**，导致生成速度暴跌至 `16.1 tok/s`，预填充更是惨不忍睹。而现在，主线 `llama.cpp` 原生内置了 **`--n-cpu-moe N`（简写 `-ncmoe N`）** 参数！当你执行 **`-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16`** 时，**全部 48 层的注意力层、路由门控与 32K KV Cache 100% 驻留在高速 GDDR7 显存内**，仅仅把前 16 层的稀疏路由专家权重（`ffn_*_exps.weight`）放进双通道 DDR5 系统内存。由于 `Qwen3-30B-A3B` 全部 48 层每次仅激活约 `2.0 GB` 专家权重，分摊到 DDR5 内存上的 16 层每次仅需读取 **约 `0.67 GB` 数据**——实测在 RTX 5070 Ti 16GB 上，生成速度直接从 `16.1 tok/s` 狂飙至 **`54.6 tok/s`（提速 3.4 倍）**，预填充高达 **`3,180 tok/s`**！
```bash
# Case A: Fit Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6GB Q4_K_M) + 32K context on a 16GB GPU (~14.1 GB VRAM used)
./build/bin/llama-server \
  -m ./models/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16 \
  -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -c 32768 -t 12

# Case B: Fit Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2GB Q4_K_M) on a 16GB GPU + 64GB DDR5 RAM (~14.4 GB VRAM + ~36 GB DDR5)
./build/bin/llama-server \
  -m ./models/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf \
  -ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 38 \
  -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -c 32768 -t 12
```

#### 2. Benchmark Matrix (12GB / 16GB / 24GB Measured) + 3GB-GDDR7 SUPER Refresh Sizing (18GB / 24GB Spec-Estimate) / 2. 12GB / 16GB / 24GB 实测吞吐对比表 + 3GB 颗粒 SUPER 新卡（18GB / 24GB 规格推算）边界分析
How many expert layers (`--n-cpu-moe N` out of 48 total layers) should you offload for each VRAM tier, and how much does NVIDIA’s transition from 2GB (16Gb) to **3GB (24Gb) GDDR7 memory ICs** on the rumored/upcoming **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB · 192-bit)** and **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB · 256-bit 32 Gbps)** change the math? Each layer of `Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M` holds **~0.35 GB of routed experts**. Offloading 16 layers saves `~5.6 GB` of VRAM (fitting a 16GB card); on an **18GB RTX 5070 SUPER**, you only need `--n-cpu-moe 6` (or `0` at `IQ4_XS`!), and on a **24GB RTX 5080 SUPER**, the entire 30B-A3B `Q4_K_M` model + 32K KV cache fits **100% inside 1,024 GB/s GDDR7 VRAM (`--n-cpu-moe 0`)**!
不同显存容量到底该设多少层 `--n-cpu-moe N`（以总计 48 层的 `Qwen3-30B-A3B` 与 `Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B` 为例）？如果换上采用单颗 **3GB (24Gb) 高密度 GDDR7 显存颗粒**的 **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB · 192-bit)** 与 **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB · 256-bit 32 Gbps)**，又会带来怎样的质变？算一笔精确的显存账：`Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M` 每一层的路由专家约占 **`0.35 GB`**。在 16GB 显卡上设 `--n-cpu-moe 16` 可省出 `5.6 GB` 显存；而在 **18GB 的 RTX 5070 SUPER** 上只需设 `--n-cpu-moe 6`（若换用 `16.2 GB` 的 `IQ4_XS` 甚至可以设 `0` 全进显存！）；到了 **24GB 的 RTX 5080 SUPER（1,024 GB/s 带宽）**，原本在 RTX 5080 16GB 上溢出的 `Qwen3-30B-A3B` 与 `Qwen3-32B` 稠密模型均可 **100% 装入 GDDR7 显存（`--n-cpu-moe 0`）**！

**Table 1: Native llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe Benchmark on Dual-Channel DDR5-6400 (32K Context, Q8_0 KV) & 18GB/24GB SUPER Sizing / 表 1：双通道 DDR5-6400 下 llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe 实测吞吐表（32K 上下文，Q8_0 KV）与 18GB/24GB SUPER 规格推算**
| GPU Tier (+ 64GB DDR5-6400) (显卡档位 (+ 64GB DDR5-6400)) | Model (`Q4_K_M`) (测试模型 (`Q4_K_M`)) | Optimal Flag (最佳卸载参数) | VRAM / DDR5 Used (显存 / 内存占用) | Prefill (`pp2048`) (预填充 (`pp2048`)) | Decode (`tg128`) (生成速度 (`tg128`)) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| RTX 4070 (12GB · 504 GB/s) [Measured] / RTX 4070 (12GB · 504 GB/s) [实测] | Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) / Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 26` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 26` | 10.4 GB / 9.8 GB / 10.4 GB / 9.8 GB | 1,640 tok/s / 1,640 tok/s | **34.8 tok/s** (vs 14.2 w/ `-ngl`) / **34.8 tok/s** (传统 `-ngl` 仅 14.2) |
| RTX 5060 Ti (16GB · 448 GB/s) [Measured] / RTX 5060 Ti (16GB · 448 GB/s) [实测] | Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) / Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16` | 14.1 GB / 6.2 GB / 14.1 GB / 6.2 GB | 1,890 tok/s / 1,890 tok/s | **46.2 tok/s** / **46.2 tok/s** |
| RTX 5070 Ti (16GB · 896 GB/s) [Measured] / RTX 5070 Ti (16GB · 896 GB/s) [实测] | Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) / Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 16` | 14.1 GB / 6.2 GB / 14.1 GB / 6.2 GB | 3,180 tok/s / 3,180 tok/s | **54.6 tok/s** / **54.6 tok/s** |
| **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB · 672 GB/s) [Spec-Est.]** / **RTX 5070 SUPER (18GB · 672 GB/s) [规格推算]** | Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) / Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 6` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 6` | ~16.4 GB / ~2.5 GB / 约 16.4 GB / 约 2.5 GB | ~2,900 tok/s (est.) / 约 2,900 tok/s (估) | **~78–86 tok/s (est.)** / **约 78–86 tok/s (估)** |
| **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB · 1024 GB/s) [Spec-Est.]** / **RTX 5080 SUPER (24GB · 1024 GB/s) [规格推算]** | Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) / Qwen3-30B-A3B (18.6 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 0` (100% GPU) / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 0` (全进显存) | ~20.6 GB / 0 GB / 约 20.6 GB / 0 GB | ~4,400 tok/s (est.) / 约 4,400 tok/s (估) | **~120–135 tok/s (est.)** / **约 120–135 tok/s (估)** |
| RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) + 64GB DDR5 [Measured] / RTX 5070 Ti (16GB) + 64GB DDR5 [实测] | Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2 GB) / Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 38` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 38` | 14.4 GB / 36.2 GB / 14.4 GB / 36.2 GB | 1,420 tok/s / 1,420 tok/s | **26.4 tok/s** / **26.4 tok/s** |
| RTX 4090 (24GB · 1008 GB/s) [Measured] / RTX 4090 (24GB · 1008 GB/s) [实测] | Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2 GB) / Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B (48.2 GB) | `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 30` / `-ngl 99 --n-cpu-moe 30` | 21.6 GB / 28.5 GB / 21.6 GB / 28.5 GB | 2,190 tok/s / 2,190 tok/s | **32.8 tok/s** / **32.8 tok/s** |

#### 3. Quick Formula to Calculate Your Exact `--n-cpu-moe N` Without Trial-and-Error OOMs / 3. 零盲猜速算公式：30 秒算出你显卡专属的 `--n-cpu-moe N` 层数
Instead of guessing `N` until CUDA crashes, use this two-line rule for 48-layer MoE models (`Qwen3-30B-A3B` has ~0.35 GB of experts per layer; `Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B` has ~0.94 GB of experts per layer at `Q4_K_M`): **1) First compute the fixed GPU footprint (Attention + Shared + 32K Q8_0 KV Cache)**, which is **~3.8 GB** for `30B-A3B` and **~5.1 GB** for `80B-A3B`. **2) Divide your remaining usable VRAM by the per-layer expert size** to find how many expert layers fit on the GPU (`L_gpu`), then set **`--n-cpu-moe = 48 - L_gpu`**! Or simply pass `--cpu-moe` (`-cmoe`) to put all 48 layers’ routed experts in DDR5 RAM while keeping 100% of attention and KV cache on the GPU.
不用反复试错等到爆显存崩溃，只需记住一条针对 48 层 MoE 模型的两步速算公式（在 `Q4_K_M` 下，`Qwen3-30B-A3B` 每层路由专家约 **`0.35 GB`**；`Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B` 每层路由专家约 **`0.94 GB`**）：**第一步，扣除必须常驻 GPU 显存的固定开销（全部 48 层 Attention + 共享层 + 32K Q8_0 KV Cache）**，`30B-A3B` 约为 **`3.8 GB`**，`80B-A3B` 约为 **`5.1 GB`**。**第二步，用你的显卡剩余可用显存除以单层专家体积**，得出 GPU 能装下的专家层数 `L_gpu`，然后令 **`--n-cpu-moe = 48 - L_gpu`** 即可！如果你懒得计算，甚至可以直接传 **`--cpu-moe`（简写 `-cmoe`）**，将全部 48 层路由专家放进 DDR5 内存、将全部注意力层留在 GPU。

#### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
- **Q**: How does `--n-cpu-moe N` compare to `ik_llama.cpp -ot "blk\.[0-9]+\.ffn_.*_exps\.weight=CPU"` from Guide #33? / 主线 `llama.cpp` 的 `--n-cpu-moe N` 与第 33 篇指南中 `ik_llama.cpp` 的 `-ot` 正则卸载有什么区别？
  **A**: `--n-cpu-moe N` is built directly into **official upstream `llama.cpp`** and lets you offload **only the first `N` layers of MoE experts** (so your 16GB/24GB GPU still accelerates the remaining `48 - N` layers of experts!), whereas a wildcard `-ot "blk\.[0-9]+..."` offloads all layers unless you write complex layer-range regexes. For 12GB–24GB desktop PCs running 30B–80B MoE models, `--n-cpu-moe N` is much simpler and works out of the box. (`--n-cpu-moe N` 直接集成在**官方主线 `llama.cpp`** 中，无需写复杂的正则表达式就能精确指定**仅把前 `N` 层的专家卸载到内存**（让你的 16GB/24GB 显卡依然全速承担剩余 `48 - N` 层专家的计算！）。对于在普通 12GB–24GB 家用台式机上跑 30B–80B MoE 模型，主线 `--n-cpu-moe N` 开箱即用、简单得多。)
- **Q**: Can I use `--n-cpu-moe` inside Ollama as well? / 在 Ollama 中也能使用类似 `--n-cpu-moe` 的专家卸载功能吗？
  **A**: Recent Ollama builds inherit `llama.cpp`’s MoE tensor-offload heuristics when a model exceeds VRAM, but `llama-server` gives you explicit deterministic control via `--n-cpu-moe N` (so Ollama never accidentally offloads full attention layers to CPU when VRAM gets tight). (新版 Ollama 虽已逐步跟进底层 `llama.cpp` 的 MoE 卸载机制，但当显存临界时仍可能把整层 Attention 一起退回 CPU。直接使用 `llama-server --n-cpu-moe N` 可以 100% 强制锁定全部注意力层在 GPU 内，性能更可控。)

---

### run-mac-benchmark.sh (Apple Silicon Mac Fixed-Task Speed & Context Benchmark Script / Mac 本地模型固定任务、上下文与生成速度复现脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/mac-benchmark-runner/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/mac-benchmark-runner/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Reproducible Mac Local LLM Benchmark (Guide #1)
set -euo pipefail

MODEL="qwen2.5:14b-instruct-q4_K_M"
CTX="8192"
API="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate"

echo "=== [1/3] Hardware & Version Snapshot ==="
uname -a
ollama --version || true

echo "=== [2/3] Running Fixed Deterministic Task (seed=42, num_ctx=$CTX) ==="
RESPONSE=$(curl -sS "$API" -d "{
  \"model\": \"$MODEL\",
  \"prompt\": \"Extract three technical risks of running local LLMs with large context windows in strict JSON format with keys: risk, cause, mitigation.\",
  \"stream\": false,
  \"options\": {
    \"num_ctx\": $CTX,
    \"temperature\": 0,
    \"seed\": 42
  }
}")

echo "$RESPONSE" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
eval_count = data.get("eval_count", 0)
eval_dur = data.get("eval_duration", 1) / 1e9
prompt_count = data.get("prompt_eval_count", 0)
prompt_dur = data.get("prompt_eval_duration", 1) / 1e9
print(f"Prompt Eval : {prompt_count} tokens ({prompt_count/prompt_dur:.2f} tok/s)")
print(f"Generation  : {eval_count} tokens ({eval_count/eval_dur:.2f} tok/s)")
'

echo "=== [3/3] Active Metal / Unified Memory Footprint ==="
ollama ps

```

### docker-compose.ollama-webui.yml (Ollama + Open WebUI Persistent Stack with Backup & Rollback Safety / Ollama + Open WebUI 持久化、备份与安全回滚栈 (Docker Compose))

```yaml
# Tinker AI Verified Stack — Ollama + Open WebUI (Guide #3)
# Pre-upgrade backup: tar -czf backup-$(date +%F).tar.gz ./tinker-local-ai-data

services:
  ollama:
    image: ollama/ollama:0.5.7
    container_name: tinker-ollama
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:11434:11434"
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:11434
      - OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1
      - OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0
      - OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL=2
      - OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE=15m
    volumes:
      - ./tinker-local-ai-data/ollama:/root/.ollama

  open-webui:
    image: ghcr.io/open-webui/open-webui:v0.5.10
    container_name: tinker-open-webui
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - ollama
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:3000:8080"
    environment:
      - OLLAMA_BASE_URL=http://ollama:11434
      - RAG_EMBEDDING_ENGINE=ollama
      - RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL=bge-m3:latest
      - ENABLE_RAG_HYBRID_SEARCH=true
      - RAG_TOP_K=5
      - SCARF_NO_ANALYTICS=true
      - DO_NOT_TRACK=true
    extra_hosts:
      - "host.docker.internal:host-gateway"
    volumes:
      - ./tinker-local-ai-data/open-webui:/app/backend/data

```

### tinker-rag-eval-sample.sh (Local Document Q&A (RAG) Downloadable Sample Corpus & Citation Verifier / 本地文档问答 (RAG) 可下载测试样例生成与引用核验脚本)

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Local Document Q&A (RAG) Sample Corpus & Citation Check (Guide #4)
set -euo pipefail

CHAT_MODEL="qwen2.5:14b-instruct-q4_K_M"
EMBED_MODEL="bge-m3"
CTX="8192"

cat << 'EOF' > ./sample-homelab-sla-policy.md
# Tinker HomeLab Storage & Backup Policy (Rev 2026.10)

## Section 3.1: RPO & Snapshot Frequency
All SQLite application databases (webui.db, n8n.sqlite) MUST be snapshotted every 6 hours using zstd compression. Maximum Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is strictly 6 hours.

## Section 3.2: Cold Storage Retention Trap
Daily archives are retained on local NVMe for 14 days, and replicated to offline NAS cold storage for 90 days. NOTE: Temporary cache directories (/root/.ollama/models/blobs) are EXCLUDED from daily tar snapshots.

## Section 4.4: Emergency Rollback Threshold
If post-upgrade p95 token latency degrades by more than 28% at num_ctx=8192, operators must revert to the previous pinned container digest within 15 minutes.
EOF

echo "=== Generated ./sample-homelab-sla-policy.md ==="
echo "=== Testing Citation Accuracy & Context Retention on $CHAT_MODEL (num_ctx=$CTX) ==="

DOC_CONTENT=$(cat ./sample-homelab-sla-policy.md)
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d "{
  \"model\": \"$CHAT_MODEL\",
  \"stream\": false,
  \"options\": { \"num_ctx\": $CTX, \"temperature\": 0 },
  \"prompt\": $(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.dumps("Answer ONLY using the document below and cite the exact Section number. Question: Are Ollama model blobs included in daily tar snapshots, and what is the p95 latency rollback threshold?

Document:
" + sys.stdin.read()))' < ./sample-homelab-sla-policy.md)
}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("response",""))'

```

### pi5-offline-ai-verify.sh (Raspberry Pi 5 Offline AI Box — Hardware & Thermal Verification Script / 树莓派 5 离线语音/视觉 AI 实验箱 — 硬件、供电与温控自检脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/pi5-voice-vision-bom/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/pi5-voice-vision-bom/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI Maker Lab — Raspberry Pi 5 Pre-Flight & BOM Verification
set -euo pipefail

echo "=== [1/4] Checking Power Supply & Thermal Throttling ==="
if command -v vcgencmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  THROTTLED=$(vcgencmd get_throttled)
  TEMP=$(vcgencmd measure_temp)
  echo "Status: $THROTTLED | Temp: $TEMP"
  if [ "$THROTTLED" != "throttled=0x0" ]; then
    echo "WARNING: Under-voltage or thermal throttling detected! Use official 5V/5A (27W) USB-C PD supply + active cooler."
  fi
fi

echo "=== [2/4] Verifying USB Audio (USB) & Camera Devices ==="
arecord -l | grep -i "USB" || echo "Notice: Matching USB microphone not found."
ls -l /dev/video* 2>/dev/null || echo "Notice: No /dev/video* camera node detected."

echo "=== [3/4] Checking Available Memory (Require >= 4.5GB Free for qwen2.5:3b) ==="
free -h

echo "=== [4/4] Smoke-Testing Offline Model (qwen2.5:3b, num_ctx=2048) ==="
ollama run "qwen2.5:3b" "Reply in 10 words: confirm offline edge node is operational."

```

### pi5-sensor-log-guardian.sh (Raspberry Pi 5 Thermal & Journalctl Log Anomaly Explainer Daemon / 树莓派 5 传感器阈值过滤与系统日志本地 AI 诊断脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/pi5-sensor-log-guardian-script/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/pi5-sensor-log-guardian-script/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI Maker Lab — Rule-First Thermal & Log Anomaly Explainer (Guide #9)
set -euo pipefail

THRESHOLD="68"
MODEL="qwen2.5:3b"

RAW_MILLI=$(cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone0/temp 2>/dev/null || echo "45000")
TEMP_C=$((RAW_MILLI / 1000))
RECENT_ERRS=$(journalctl -p err..warning -n 15 --no-pager 2>/dev/null || echo "No systemd errors.")

echo "[Rule Check] Current Temp: ${TEMP_C}°C (Threshold: ${THRESHOLD}°C)"

if [ "$TEMP_C" -ge "$THRESHOLD" ]; then
  echo "[Anomaly Triggered] Invoking local $MODEL for root-cause synthesis..."
  curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d "{
    \"model\": \"$MODEL\",
    \"stream\": false,
    \"options\": { \"temperature\": 0.1, \"num_ctx\": 2048 },
    \"prompt\": \"Hardware alert: Pi 5 temperature reached ${TEMP_C}C. Summarize likely cause and 2 check commands from logs: \n${RECENT_ERRS}\"
  }" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("response",""))'
else
  echo "[OK] Within safe thermal boundary; skipping LLM inference (0% CPU overhead)."
fi

```

### diagnose-container-llm.sh (Container-to-Host Local LLM Connectivity Diagnostic Script / 容器连不上宿主机本地模型：最小复现与跨平台诊断脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/container-host-diag-script/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/container-host-diag-script/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI Troubleshooting — Container <-> Host Local Model Diagnostic (Guide #6)
set -euo pipefail

PORT="11434"
CONTAINER="tinker-open-webui"

echo "=== Step 1: Check Host Listening Address on Port $PORT ==="
if lsof -nP -iTCP:"$PORT" -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | grep -q "127.0.0.1:$PORT"; then
  echo "[FAIL] Host service is bound ONLY to 127.0.0.1:$PORT."
  echo "  -> Fix: Set OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0:$PORT on the host service and restart."
else
  echo "[OK] Host service is not restricted to loopback only."
fi

echo "=== Step 2: Probe host.docker.internal from inside $CONTAINER ==="
docker exec "$CONTAINER" sh -c "getent hosts host.docker.internal && wget -qO- --timeout=5 http://host.docker.internal:$PORT/api/version" \
  && echo "[OK] Container reached host model API successfully!" \
  || echo "[FAIL] Container cannot reach host.docker.internal:$PORT. Ensure extra_hosts: ['host.docker.internal:host-gateway'] is set."

```

### sse-stream-guard.mjs (Resilient LLM SSE Stream Reader (Handles Post-HTTP-200 Mid-Stream Errors) / 抗中断 LLM SSE 流式解析器（捕获 HTTP 200 后的流内报错与截断）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/sse-stream-guard-client/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/sse-stream-guard-client/
```javascript
// Tinker AI — Resilient SSE Stream Reader with Mid-Stream Error Detection
const API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions";
const IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = Number("15000");

export async function consumeLlmStream(payload) {
  const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ ...payload, stream: true }),
  });

  if (!res.ok || !res.body) {
    throw new Error(`Pre-stream HTTP failure: ${res.status}`);
  }

  const reader = res.body.getReader();
  const decoder = new TextDecoder();
  let buffer = "";
  let output = "";

  while (true) {
    const timer = setTimeout(() => reader.cancel("SSE chunk idle timeout"), IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS);
    const { value, done } = await reader.read().finally(() => clearTimeout(timer));
    if (done) break;

    buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
    const lines = buffer.split("\n");
    buffer = lines.pop() ?? "";

    for (const raw of lines) {
      const line = raw.trim();
      if (!line.startsWith("data:")) continue;
      const data = line.slice(5).trim();
      if (data === "[DONE]") return { output, completed: true };

      const event = JSON.parse(data);
      // Catch mid-stream error frame sent AFTER HTTP 200 OK
      if (event.error || event.type === "error") {
        throw new Error(`Mid-stream SSE error after HTTP 200: ${ JSON.stringify(event.error || event) }`);
      }
      const delta = event.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content ?? "";
      output += delta;
    }
  }
  return { output, completed: false };
}

```

### benchmark-concurrent-llm.sh (Multi-Worker Concurrency & P95 TTFT Benchmark Script (Ollama vs vLLM) / 本地模型多并发吞吐量与 P95 首字延迟 (TTFT) 压测脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/vllm-concurrency-bench-script/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/vllm-concurrency-bench-script/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Concurrent Local LLM Throughput & Queue Latency Probe
set -euo pipefail

ENDPOINT="http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1/chat/completions"
MODEL="qwen2.5:7b"
WORKERS="4"

echo "=== Firing $WORKERS Parallel Requests against $MODEL ($ENDPOINT) ==="
START_TS=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.time())')

seq 1 "$WORKERS" | xargs -I{} -P "$WORKERS" bash -c '
  REQ_START=$(python3 -c "import time; print(time.time())")
  RESP=$(curl -sS "'"$ENDPOINT"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{
    \"model\": \"'"$MODEL"'\",
    \"temperature\": 0,
    \"max_tokens\": 160,
    \"messages\": [{\"role\": \"user\", \"content\": \"Worker #{}: List 3 key differences between continuous batching and static request queues in 80 words.\"}]
  }")
  REQ_END=$(python3 -c "import time; print(time.time())")
  python3 -c "
import json, sys
d = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
toks = d.get("usage", {}).get("completion_tokens", 0)
dur = float(sys.argv[3]) - float(sys.argv[2])
print(f"[Worker #{}] Completed in {dur:.2f}s | {toks} tokens ({toks/max(0.01,dur):.1f} tok/s)")
" "$RESP" "$REQ_START" "$REQ_END"
'

END_TS=$(python3 -c 'import time; print(time.time())')
python3 -c "print(f'=== Total Wall-Clock Duration for $WORKERS parallel requests: {float($END_TS)-float($START_TS):.2f}s ===')"

```

### nginx-ollama-lan-auth.conf (Secure LAN Reverse Proxy for Ollama / vLLM (Bearer Auth + CORS + Unbuffered SSE) / 本地模型局域网安全反向代理配置（Bearer 鉴权 + CORS 放行 + 零缓冲流式转发）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/caddy-nginx-ollama-auth-proxy/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/caddy-nginx-ollama-auth-proxy/
```shell
# Tinker AI — Secure Nginx Reverse Proxy for Local Ollama (Keep Ollama on 127.0.0.1:11434)
map $http_authorization $auth_ok {
    default 0;
    "Bearer sk-tinker-homelab-secret-2026" 1;
}

server {
    listen 0.0.0.0:11435;
    server_name _;

    location / {
        # Handle browser / Chrome extension CORS preflight
        if ($request_method = OPTIONS) {
            add_header Access-Control-Allow-Origin "*" always;
            add_header Access-Control-Allow-Methods "GET, POST, OPTIONS" always;
            add_header Access-Control-Allow-Headers "Authorization, Content-Type" always;
            return 204;
        }

        if ($auth_ok = 0) {
            return 401 '{"error":"Unauthorized: valid Bearer token required"}';
        }

        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:11434;
        proxy_set_header Host localhost:11434;
        proxy_buffering off;
        proxy_cache off;
        proxy_read_timeout 300s;
        chunked_transfer_encoding on;
    }
}

```

### ocr-pdf-to-markdown.sh (Local Vision LLM (Qwen2.5-VL / Gemma-3) Scanned PDF & Table Extractor Script / 本地视觉模型 (Qwen2.5-VL / Gemma-3) 扫描件 PDF 与跨页表格提取脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/qwen25vl-ocr-table-extractor/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/qwen25vl-ocr-table-extractor/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Reproducible Local Vision OCR & Table Extractor (Guide #17)
set -euo pipefail

MODEL="qwen2.5vl:7b"
DPI="150"
API="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate"
INPUT_PDF="${1:-sample-scanned-invoice.pdf}"
OUT_DIR="./ocr-output"

mkdir -p "$OUT_DIR"
echo "=== [1/3] Rasterizing $INPUT_PDF at ${DPI} DPI (Sweet spot for Vision Token budget) ==="
if command -v pdftoppm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  pdftoppm -png -r "$DPI" "$INPUT_PDF" "$OUT_DIR/page"
else
  echo "[INFO] pdftoppm (poppler) not found; assuming $INPUT_PDF is already an image."
  cp "$INPUT_PDF" "$OUT_DIR/page-1.png"
fi

for IMG in "$OUT_DIR"/page*.png; do
  [ -e "$IMG" ] || continue
  echo "=== [2/3] Extracting Markdown Table from $IMG via $MODEL ==="
  B64_IMG=$(base64 < "$IMG" | tr -d '\n')
  curl -sS "$API" -d "{
    \"model\": \"$MODEL\",
    \"stream\": false,
    \"options\": { \"temperature\": 0, \"num_ctx\": 8192 },
    \"prompt\": \"Transcribe all text and reconstruct any tables into strict GitHub Flavored Markdown. Preserve exact numbers, currency symbols, and column headers. Do not invent missing rows.\",
    \"images\": [\"$B64_IMG\"]
  }" | python3 -c '
import sys, json
res = json.load(sys.stdin)
print(res.get("response", ""))
eval_c = res.get("eval_count", 0)
eval_d = res.get("eval_duration", 1) / 1e9
print(f"
--- [Stats] Generated {eval_c} tokens at {eval_c/eval_d:.2f} tok/s ---")
'
done

echo "=== [3/3] Checking Active Vision Model VRAM Footprint ==="
ollama ps

```

### pi5-voice-assistant-loop.sh (Raspberry Pi 5 Offline Voice Loop Script (Whisper.cpp STT + Ollama + Piper TTS) / 树莓派 5 纯离线语音对话闭环脚本（Whisper.cpp 识别 + Ollama + Piper 语音合成）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/pi5-offline-voice-loop-script/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/pi5-offline-voice-loop-script/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI Maker Lab — Raspberry Pi 5 100% Offline Voice Assistant Loop (Guide #19)
set -euo pipefail

MIC="plughw:1,0"
WHISPER_BIN="${WHISPER_BIN:-./whisper-cli}"
WHISPER_MODEL="./models/ggml-base-q5_1.bin"
LLM_MODEL="qwen2.5:3b"
PIPER_VOICE="./voices/zh_CN-huayan-medium.onnx"

echo "=== [1/4] Recording 4s Voice Command from $MIC (16kHz Mono PCM) ==="
arecord -D "$MIC" -f S16_LE -r 16000 -c 1 -d 4 /tmp/pi5-query.wav

echo "=== [2/4] Running Local Whisper.cpp STT (4 Cortex-A76 Threads) ==="
USER_TEXT=$("$WHISPER_BIN" -m "$WHISPER_MODEL" -t 4 -np -nt -f /tmp/pi5-query.wav | tr -d '\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//')
echo "Heard: ${USER_TEXT:-<silence>}"

if [ -z "$USER_TEXT" ]; then
  echo "No speech detected; skipping LLM."
  exit 0
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Querying Local Ollama ($LLM_MODEL, num_ctx=2048) ==="
REPLY=$(curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d "{
  \"model\": \"$LLM_MODEL\",
  \"stream\": false,
  \"options\": { \"num_ctx\": 2048, \"temperature\": 0.3, \"num_predict\": 120 },
  \"prompt\": \"Answer concisely in 1-2 spoken sentences without markdown symbols: $USER_TEXT\"
}" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("response","").strip())')

echo "Reply: $REPLY"

echo "=== [4/4] Synthesizing Speech via Local Piper TTS (Half-Duplex Playback) ==="
if command -v piper >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  printf "%s" "$REPLY" | piper --model "$PIPER_VOICE" --output-raw | aplay -r 22050 -f S16_LE -t raw -
else
  echo "[INFO] Piper binary not found in PATH; printed text response above."
fi

```

### check-rag-embedding-health.sh (Local RAG Embedding Dimension, Bilingual Recall & Zombie VRAM Diagnostic Script / 本地 RAG 向量维度校验、双语余弦相似度与僵尸显存排查脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/rag-vector-dim-healthcheck/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/rag-vector-dim-healthcheck/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — RAG Embedding Dimension & Multi-Model VRAM Healthcheck (Guide #20)
set -euo pipefail

EMBED="bge-m3:latest"
EXP_DIM="1024"
API="http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/embed"

echo "=== [1/3] Probing Vector Dimension for $EMBED ==="
RESP=$(curl -sS "$API" -d "{
  \"model\": \"$EMBED\",
  \"input\": [\"Tinker AI Lab bilingual RAG verification\", \"本地知识库跨语言向量检索测试\"],
  \"keep_alive\": \"5m\"
}")

echo "$RESP" | python3 -c "
import sys, json, math
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
vecs = data.get('embeddings', [])
if not vecs:
    print('[FAIL] Empty embeddings array returned! Check model tag.')
    sys.exit(1)
dim = len(vecs[0])
exp = int('$EXP_DIM')
status = 'OK' if dim == exp else f'MISMATCH (Expected {exp}, Got {dim} -> Must re-index Vector DB!)'
dot = sum(a*b for a, b in zip(vecs[0], vecs[1]))
norm0 = math.sqrt(sum(a*a for a in vecs[0]))
norm1 = math.sqrt(sum(b*b for b in vecs[1]))
cos = dot / (norm0 * norm1) if (norm0 and norm1) else 0.0
print(f'Vector Dimension : {dim} [{status}]')
print(f'EN-ZH Cosine Sim : {cos:.4f} (Expect > 0.55 for multilingual models like bge-m3)')
"

echo "=== [2/3] Inspecting Co-Loaded Models & VRAM Split ==="
ollama ps

echo "=== [3/3] Checking OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS Policy ==="
echo "Tip: Ensure OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS>=2 so $EMBED and your Chat LLM do not thrash disk on every RAG query."

```

### tune-strix-halo-llm.sh (AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo 128GB) GTT/TTM Memory & MoE Benchmark Script / AMD Strix Halo (128GB 统一内存) 96GB 显存池核验与 Qwen3-MoE 实测脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/strix-halo-uma-tuner/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/strix-halo-uma-tuner/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo 128GB · gfx1151) UMA & LLM Verifier (Guide #21)
set -euo pipefail

MODEL="qwen3:30b-a3b-q4_K_M"
TARGET_PAGES="25165824"
CTX="32768"

echo "=== [1/4] Kernel, BIOS UMA & TTM Page Limit Audit ==="
uname -r
if [ -f /sys/module/amdttm/parameters/pages_limit ]; then
  CUR_PAGES=$(cat /sys/module/amdttm/parameters/pages_limit)
  CUR_GB=$(( CUR_PAGES * 4 / 1024 / 1024 ))
  echo "Current amdttm.pages_limit: $CUR_PAGES (~$CUR_GB GB addressable GTT pool)"
  if [ "$CUR_PAGES" -lt "$TARGET_PAGES" ]; then
    echo "[WARN] GTT pool is below target ($TARGET_PAGES pages). Add 'amdttm.pages_limit=$TARGET_PAGES amdttm.page_pool_size=$TARGET_PAGES' to GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX_DEFAULT."
  fi
fi

echo "=== [2/4] Verifying Radeon 8060S (gfx1151) Visible VRAM ==="
if command -v rocminfo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rocminfo | grep -E "Name:\s+gfx|Size:" | head -n 6 || true
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Applying Strix Halo ROCm hipBLASLt & Flash Attention Optimizations ==="
export ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1
export OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1
export OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0
echo "Exported ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1 OLLAMA_FLASH_ATTENTION=1 OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0"

echo "=== [4/4] Benchmarking $MODEL at num_ctx=$CTX (seed=42) ==="
curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d "{
  \"model\": \"$MODEL\",
  \"prompt\": \"/no_think Compare sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) memory bandwidth utilization against dense 70B models on 256 GB/s unified memory in 3 bullet points.\",
  \"stream\": false,
  \"options\": { \"num_ctx\": $CTX, \"temperature\": 0, \"seed\": 42 }
}" | python3 -c "
import sys, json
d = json.load(sys.stdin)
ec = d.get('eval_count', 0)
ed = d.get('eval_duration', 1) / 1e9
pc = d.get('prompt_eval_count', 0)
pd = d.get('prompt_eval_duration', 1) / 1e9
print(f'Prefill Speed : {pc} tokens ({pc/pd:.1f} tok/s)')
print(f'Decode Speed  : {ec} tokens ({ec/ed:.2f} tok/s)')
"
ollama ps

```

### diagnose-uma-and-arc-gpu.sh (Cross-Vendor New Hardware GPU Probe (AMD Strix Halo GTT · Intel Arc B580 · NVIDIA UMA) / 新一代本地 AI 硬件显存与驱动排障脚本（AMD Strix Halo · Intel Arc B580 · NVIDIA 统一内存）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/new-hardware-gpu-diag-script/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/new-hardware-gpu-diag-script/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — New Hardware GPU & Unified Memory Diagnostic Probe (Guide #24)
set -euo pipefail

DRI_DEV="/dev/dri/renderD128"
MIN_GB="24"

echo "=== [1/4] Kernel Boot Parameters & Deprecated Flag Check ==="
CMDLINE=$(cat /proc/cmdline 2>/dev/null || echo "N/A")
echo "Kernel: $(uname -r) | Cmdline: $CMDLINE"
if echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q "amdgpu.gttsize"; then
  echo "[WARN] Deprecated 'amdgpu.gttsize' detected! On Linux 6.14+, migrate to 'amdttm.pages_limit' + 'amdttm.page_pool_size' or BIOS UMA Frame Buffer."
fi

echo "=== [2/4] AMD Strix Halo (gfx1151) / ROCm TTM Memory Ceiling ==="
if [ -f /sys/module/amdttm/parameters/pages_limit ]; then
  PAGES=$(cat /sys/module/amdttm/parameters/pages_limit)
  POOL_GB=$(( PAGES * 4 / 1024 / 1024 ))
  echo "amdttm.pages_limit = $PAGES (~$POOL_GB GB)"
  if [ "$POOL_GB" -lt "$MIN_GB" ]; then
    echo "[FAIL] Addressable GTT pool ($POOL_GB GB) is below required $MIN_GB GB!"
  fi
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Intel Arc B580 (Xe2) & Linux DRI Render Group Audit ==="
if [ -e "$DRI_DEV" ]; then
  RENDER_GID=$(stat -c "%g" "$DRI_DEV" 2>/dev/null || stat -f "%g" "$DRI_DEV")
  echo "Found $DRI_DEV -> Host render GID is $RENDER_GID (Pass '--group-add $RENDER_GID' to Docker)"
else
  echo "No $DRI_DEV device found on this host."
fi

echo "=== [4/4] Unified Memory (DGX Spark / Strix Halo / Jetson) Page Cache Pressure ==="
free -g || vm_stat || true
echo "If 'buff/cache' is holding >20GB on a Unified Memory Linux host and causing cudaMallocManaged/ROCm OOM, run:"
echo "  sync && echo 3 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches"

```

### diagnose-sm120-and-gfx1201.sh (Blackwell (`sm_120`) & RDNA 4 (`gfx1201`) Kernel, PCIe Gen5 AER & ROCm Diagnostic Script / Blackwell (`sm_120`) 与 RDNA 4 (`gfx1201`) 算子兼容性、PCIe 5.0 信号与 ROCm 诊断脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/blackwell-rdna4-compute-doctor/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/blackwell-rdna4-compute-doctor/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Blackwell (sm_120) & RDNA 4 (gfx1201) Compute Doctor (Guide #28)
set -euo pipefail

SM_TARGET="12.0"
GFX_TARGET="gfx1201"

echo "=== [1/4] NVIDIA Blackwell ($SM_TARGET) Driver & PCIe Link Audit ==="
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,compute_cap,pcie.link.gen.current,pcie.link.gen.max,power.draw,power.limit --format=csv
else
  echo "No nvidia-smi detected; skipping NVIDIA check."
fi

echo "=== [2/4] PyTorch / CUDA sm_120 Kernel Image Verification ==="
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  python3 -c "
import sys
try:
    import torch
    arches = torch.cuda.get_arch_list()
    print('PyTorch:', torch.__version__, '| CUDA:', torch.version.cuda, '| Arches:', arches)
    if not any('12.0' in a or '120' in a for a in arches):
        print('[FAIL] PyTorch build lacks sm_120! Install CUDA 12.8 (+cu128) wheels or set TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="12.0+PTX".')
except Exception as e:
    print('Torch check skipped:', e)
"
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Kernel PCIe 5.0 AER & NVRM Xid 79 Bus Drop Audit ==="
dmesg -T 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "AER|Xid|fallen off the bus|amdgpu.*error" | tail -n 15 || echo "[OK] Zero PCIe AER or GPU Xid errors found."

echo "=== [4/4] AMD RDNA 4 ($GFX_TARGET) ROCm Override Trap Check ==="
if [ -n "${HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION:-}" ]; then
  echo "[WARN] HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=$HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION is set! On $GFX_TARGET (RDNA 4), spoofing gfx1100 causes INVALID_ISA crashes. Run: unset HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION"
else
  echo "[OK] HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION is not polluting the environment."
fi

```

### run-dgx-spark-200gbe-vllm.sh (NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 128GB / Dual 256GB) 200GbE RoCEv2 & UMA Cache Launcher / NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 128GB / 双机 256GB) 200GbE RoCEv2 与页缓存清理启动脚本)

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10) UMA Cache Flush & 200GbE RoCEv2 vLLM Runner (Guide #29)

IFACE="enp1s0f0np0"
HEAD_IP="192.168.10.1"
MODEL="Qwen/Qwen3-235B-A22B-FP8"
```

### diagnose-p2p-and-rocev2.sh (Multi-GPU PCIe P2P (`iommu=pt` / ACS) & 200GbE RoCEv2 Diagnostic Script / 多卡 PCIe P2P (`iommu=pt` / ACS) 与 200GbE RoCEv2 互联一键体检脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/multi-gpu-p2p-rocev2-doctor/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/multi-gpu-p2p-rocev2-doctor/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Multi-GPU PCIe P2P & ConnectX-7 200GbE RoCEv2 Doctor (Guide #32)
set -euo pipefail

IFACE="enp1s0f0np0"
TARGET_MTU="9000"

echo "=== [1/4] Auditing Kernel IOMMU Passthrough (iommu=pt) ==="
CMDLINE=$(cat /proc/cmdline)
echo "Kernel cmdline: $CMDLINE"
if echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q "iommu=pt"; then
  echo "[OK] iommu=pt is active (direct PCIe BAR1 P2P DMA enabled)."
else
  echo "[WARN] iommu=pt is MISSING! Multi-GPU vLLM (TP>=2) on AMD/Intel boards may deadlock. Add iommu=pt to GRUB or set export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1."
fi

echo "=== [2/4] Checking PCIe ACS Redirection & GPU P2P Matrix ==="
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nvidia-smi topo -p2p r || true
elif command -v rocm-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  rocm-smi --showtopo || true
fi
sudo lspci -vvv 2>/dev/null | grep -E "ACSCtl:.*SrcValid\+" | head -n 5 && echo "[INFO] PCIe ACS is enabled on bridge ports; if NCCL hangs, export NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 or disable ACS in BIOS." || true

echo "=== [3/4] Checking ConnectX-7 / RDMA Devices & Interface MTU ($IFACE -> $TARGET_MTU) ==="
if ip link show "$IFACE" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  ip -br link show "$IFACE"
  ip link show "$IFACE" | grep -q "mtu $TARGET_MTU" && echo "[OK] $IFACE MTU is $TARGET_MTU" || echo "[WARN] $IFACE MTU is not $TARGET_MTU! Run: sudo ip link set dev $IFACE mtu $TARGET_MTU"
fi

echo "=== [4/4] Inspecting RoCEv2 GID Index Table ==="
if command -v show_gids >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  show_gids | grep -i "v2" | head -n 8 || true
  echo "Recommended NCCL env: export NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0:1 NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=$IFACE"
fi

```

### run-epyc-hybrid-moe-llm.sh (AMD EPYC 12-Ch DDR5 + Single GPU Hybrid MoE (`ik_llama.cpp` `-ot` & `KTransformers`) Launcher / AMD EPYC 12 通道 DDR5 + 单张独显异构 MoE (`ik_llama.cpp` `-ot` 与 `KTransformers`) 启动脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/epyc-hybrid-moe-ktransformers-ik-runner/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/epyc-hybrid-moe-ktransformers-ik-runner/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — AMD EPYC 12-Channel DDR5 + Single GPU Hybrid MoE Launcher (Guide #33)
set -euo pipefail

ENGINE="ik_llama"
MODEL_PATH="/mnt/nvme/models/DeepSeek-R1-671B-IQ4_XS.gguf"
THREADS="32"
CTX="32768"

echo "=== [1/3] Auditing NUMA Topology & Disabling Linux Auto-NUMA Thrashing ==="
sudo sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0 >/dev/null || true
numactl --hardware | head -n 10 || true

echo "=== [2/3] Flushing VFS Page Cache Before Mapping 250GB–400GB MoE Weights ==="
sync && echo 3 | sudo tee /proc/sys/vm/drop_caches >/dev/null

echo "=== [3/3] Launching Hybrid GPU (Attention+KV) + CPU (MoE Experts) Engine: $ENGINE ==="
if [ "$ENGINE" = "ktransformers" ]; then
  export USE_NUMA=1
  python3 -m ktransformers.server.main \
    --gguf_path "$(dirname "$MODEL_PATH")" \
    --cpu_infer "$THREADS" \
    --max_new_tokens 4096 \
    --cache_lens "$CTX" \
    --port 8080
else
  # ik_llama.cpp: -ngl 99 puts shared/attention layers on GPU, while -ot offloads routed MoE experts to 12-ch DDR5 CPU
  numactl --interleave=all ./build/bin/llama-server \
    -m "$MODEL_PATH" \
    -ngl 99 \
    -ot "blk\.[0-9]+\.ffn_.*_exps\.weight=CPU" \
    -fa -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 \
    -c "$CTX" -t "$THREADS" \
    --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080
fi

```

### launch-blackwell-pro5000-5080-speculative.sh (Blackwell RTX PRO 5000 (72GB) / PRO 4500 (32GB) & RTX 5080 / 5070 Ti Speculative Decoding Runner / Blackwell RTX PRO 5000 (72GB) / PRO 4500 (32GB) 与 RTX 5080 / 5070 Ti 投机解码启动脚本)

### setup-hailo10h-and-rk3588-edge-llm.sh (Jetson AGX Thor (T5000), Pi 5 AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H` 8GB) & RK3588 NPU Edge LLM Bootstrap / Jetson AGX Thor (T5000)、树莓派 5 AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H` 8GB) 与 RK3588 边缘大模型部署脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/edge-thor-hailo10h-rk3588-bootstrap/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/edge-thor-hailo10h-rk3588-bootstrap/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Next-Gen Edge LLM Bootstrap: Hailo-10H (8GB) / RK3588 NPU / Jetson Thor (Guide #35)
set -euo pipefail

PLATFORM="hailo10h"
MODEL_TAG="qwen2.5-instruct:1.5b"
PORT="11434"

echo "=== [1/3] Auditing Edge Accelerator Platform: $PLATFORM ==="
if [ "$PLATFORM" = "hailo10h" ]; then
  lspci | grep -i "Hailo" || echo "[WARN] Hailo-10H not detected on PCIe bus!"
  hailortcli fw-control identify || true
  echo "=== [2/3] Starting hailo-ollama on Dedicated 8GB NPU RAM (Port $PORT) ==="
  HAILO_OLLAMA_HOST="0.0.0.0:$PORT" hailo-ollama serve &
  sleep 2
  curl -sS "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/api/tags" || true
elif [ "$PLATFORM" = "rk3588" ]; then
  echo "=== [2/3] Locking RK3588 6 TOPS NPU & DMC Memory Frequency to Performance ==="
  ulimit -l unlimited || true
  cat /sys/kernel/debug/rknpu/version 2>/dev/null || true
  grep -i "Cma" /proc/meminfo || true
  echo "Ready to launch rkllm_server with W4A16 .rkllm model on port $PORT."
else
  echo "=== [2/3] Jetson AGX Thor (T5000 128GB): Locking nvpmodel & jetson_clocks ==="
  sudo nvpmodel -q || true
  sudo jetson_clocks --show || true
  echo "=== [3/3] Launching TensorRT Edge-LLM / vLLM NVFP4 for $MODEL_TAG ==="
fi

```

### diagnose-hybrid-moe-and-edge-npu.sh (Hybrid CPU+GPU MoE (`NUMA` / `-ot` Regex) & Edge NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) Doctor / 异构 CPU+GPU 大模型 (`NUMA` / `-ot` 正则) 与边缘 NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) 排障体检脚本)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/hybrid-moe-and-edge-npu-doctor/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/hybrid-moe-and-edge-npu-doctor/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Hybrid CPU+GPU MoE NUMA & Edge NPU (Hailo-10H / RK3588) Doctor (Guide #36)
set -euo pipefail

MIN_CMA="256"
MAX_VRAM="22500"

echo "=== [1/4] Checking Linux Auto-NUMA Balancing & Socket Interleaving ==="
if [ -f /proc/sys/kernel/numa_balancing ]; then
  NB=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/numa_balancing)
  echo "kernel.numa_balancing = $NB"
  if [ "$NB" = "1" ]; then
    echo "[WARN] Auto-NUMA balancing is ON (1)! On multi-node EPYC/Xeon running KTransformers or ik_llama.cpp, this causes 50-65% decode slowdown. Fix: sudo sysctl -w kernel.numa_balancing=0"
  else
    echo "[OK] Auto-NUMA balancing is disabled."
  fi
fi

echo "=== [2/4] Checking GPU Free VRAM vs Hybrid MoE Attention + KV Budget ($MAX_VRAM MB) ==="
if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,memory.used,memory.free --format=csv
  echo "Tip: If ik_llama.cpp -ngl 99 OOMs on 671B/235B MoE, ensure regex matches routed experts: -ot 'blk\.[0-9]+\.ffn_.*_exps\.weight=CPU'"
fi

echo "=== [3/4] Checking Hailo-10H (AI HAT+ 2) PCIe Link Width & Firmware ==="
if command -v hailortcli >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  hailortcli fw-control identify || echo "[WARN] hailortcli failed: verify hailo-h10-all package (do not mix with hailo-all for Hailo-8)!"
fi

echo "=== [4/4] Checking Contiguous Memory Allocator (CMA >= $MIN_CMA MB) & Memlock Limits ==="
grep -i "Cma" /proc/meminfo || true
echo "Current max locked memory (ulimit -l): $(ulimit -l)"

```

### bench-unified-memory-ai-pc.sh (RTX Spark / Gorgon Halo Unified-Memory Fixed Benchmark (llama-bench + sustained decode) / RTX Spark / Gorgon Halo 统一内存固定基准脚本（llama-bench + 持续生成）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/rtx-spark-gorgon-halo-unified-memory-bench/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/rtx-spark-gorgon-halo-unified-memory-bench/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Unified-Memory AI PC Fixed Benchmark: RTX Spark (N1X) / Ryzen AI Max+ PRO 495 (Guide #37)
set -euo pipefail

MODEL="./models/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Q4_K_M.gguf"
BIN="./build/bin"
SUSTAIN="600"
OUT="bench-$(hostname)-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M).md"

echo "=== [1/4] Model integrity ==="
sha256sum "$MODEL" | tee -a "$OUT"

echo "=== [2/4] Platform snapshot ==="
{
  echo "- arch: $(uname -m)"
  if command -v nvidia-smi >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "- gpu: $(nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv,noheader)"
  fi
  for f in /sys/class/drm/card*/device/mem_info_gtt_total; do
    [ -r "$f" ] && echo "- amdgpu GTT total: $(awk '{printf "%.1f GB", $1/1024/1024/1024}' "$f")"
  done
} | tee -a "$OUT"

echo "=== [3/4] llama-bench pp2048 / tg128 x3 (flash attention on) ==="
"$BIN/llama-bench" -m "$MODEL" -ngl 99 -fa 1 -p 2048 -n 128 -r 3 -o md | tee -a "$OUT"

echo "=== [4/4] Sustained decode for $SUSTAIN s (thermal check) ==="
timeout "$SUSTAIN" "$BIN/llama-cli" -m "$MODEL" -ngl 99 -fa -n -1 --ignore-eos \
  -p "Write a long technical report about memory bandwidth and local LLM inference." \
  2>&1 | grep -E "eval time|tokens per second" | tail -n 3 | tee -a "$OUT" || true

echo "Results written to $OUT — compare against Table 2 estimates in the guide."

```

### bench-m6-memory-tier.sh (Apple M6 MacBook Pro Memory-Tier Benchmark (wired limit + swap guard) / Apple M6 MacBook Pro 内存档位基准脚本（锁定上限 + 交换检测）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/apple-m6-memory-tier-bench/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/apple-m6-memory-tier-bench/
```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Apple M6 MacBook Pro Memory-Tier Benchmark (Guide #38)
set -euo pipefail

MODEL="./models/Qwen3-14B-Q4_K_M.gguf"
WIRED="0"
PROMPT_TOKENS="2048"

echo "=== [1/4] Chip & memory tier ==="
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | grep -E "Chip|Memory"

echo "=== [2/4] GPU wired-memory limit ==="
if [ "$WIRED" != "0" ]; then
  sudo sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb="$WIRED"
fi
sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb

swapins() { vm_stat | awk '/Swapins/ {gsub("\\.","",$2); print $2}'; }
BEFORE=$(swapins)

echo "=== [3/4] llama-bench pp$PROMPT_TOKENS / tg128 x3, Q8_0 KV ==="
llama-bench -m "$MODEL" -ngl 99 -fa 1 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 -p "$PROMPT_TOKENS" -n 128 -r 3 -o md

AFTER=$(swapins)
echo "=== [4/4] Swap guard ==="
if [ "$AFTER" -gt "$BEFORE" ]; then
  echo "[INVALID] macOS swapped $((AFTER - BEFORE)) pages during the run — this model is too large for this memory tier."
else
  echo "[OK] No swap during benchmark — result is valid for this memory tier."
fi

```

### launch-llama-cpp-n-cpu-moe.sh (llama.cpp Native --n-cpu-moe Hybrid GPU+DDR5 MoE Launcher (12GB–24GB VRAM) / llama.cpp 原生 --n-cpu-moe 消费级独显 + 双通道 DDR5 异构 MoE 启动脚本（12GB–24GB 显存）)
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/artifacts/llama-cpp-n-cpu-moe-hybrid-launcher/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/artifacts/llama-cpp-n-cpu-moe-hybrid-launcher/
```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Tinker AI — Mainstream 12GB–24GB GPU + Dual-Channel DDR5 MoE Offload Launcher (Guide #40)
set -euo pipefail
```

## Local LLM Hardware Usable Limits & Model Presets Reference

- **Apple Silicon Mac (16GB Unified)** (Apple Silicon Mac（16GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **11.5 GB** | Bandwidth: 120 GB/s — macOS reserves ~4.5GB for OS & WindowServer; exceeding ~11.5GB triggers SSD swap and severe slowdown.
- **MacBook Pro M3 Pro (18GB Unified)** (MacBook Pro M3 Pro（18GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 18 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **13.2 GB** | Bandwidth: 150 GB/s — Fits 14B Q4_K_M up to 16K context when OLLAMA_KV_CACHE_TYPE=q8_0 is enabled.
- **Apple Silicon Mac (24GB Unified)** (Apple Silicon Mac（24GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 24 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **18 GB** | Bandwidth: 150 GB/s — Comfortable sweet spot for 14B Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M models with 16K–32K context.
- **MacBook Pro M6 (16GB Unified · 153GB/s)** (MacBook Pro M6（16GB 统一内存 · 153GB/s）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **10.5 GB** | Bandwidth: 153 GB/s — 8B-class machine: Qwen3-8B Q4_K_M fits with room for 16K context; 14B is tight and needs other apps closed.
- **MacBook Pro M6 (24GB Unified · 170GB/s)** (MacBook Pro M6（24GB 统一内存 · 170GB/s）): Total Memory 24 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **17 GB** | Bandwidth: 170 GB/s — 14B sweet spot; Gemma 3 27B Q4 is borderline and Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M (18.6GB) does not fit without swap.
- **MacBook Pro M6 (32GB Unified · 170GB/s)** (MacBook Pro M6（32GB 统一内存 · 170GB/s）): Total Memory 32 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **22 GB** | Bandwidth: 170 GB/s — Unlocks Qwen3-30B-A3B Q4_K_M (~55 tok/s est.); raise iogpu.wired_limit_mb to ~26GB for 32B dense models.
- **Mac mini M4 Pro (24GB Unified · 273GB/s)** (Mac mini M4 Pro（24GB 统一内存 · 273GB/s）): Total Memory 24 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **18.2 GB** | Bandwidth: 273 GB/s — 273 GB/s Thunderbolt 5 compact desktop server; ~1.7x faster token generation than base M2/M3/M4 24GB.
- **MacBook Pro M3/M4 Max (36GB Unified)** (MacBook Pro M3/M4 Pro/Max（36GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 36 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **27.5 GB** | Bandwidth: 300 GB/s — Can run 32B Q4_K_M entirely in Metal memory with moderate context.
- **MacBook Pro M3/M4 Max (48GB Unified)** (MacBook Pro M3/M4 Max（48GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 48 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **37 GB** | Bandwidth: 400 GB/s — 400GB/s memory bus; runs 32B Q5_K_M / Q6_K with 32K+ context + local embedding model simultaneously.
- **Mac Studio / MacBook Pro Max (64GB)** (Mac Studio / MacBook Pro Max（64GB 统一内存）): Total Memory 64 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **49 GB** | Bandwidth: 400 GB/s — High-bandwidth unified memory capable of 70B Q4_K_M or 32B Q8_0 with large context.
- **Mac Studio Ultra / M4 Max (128GB · 546GB/s)** (Mac Studio Ultra / M4 Max（128GB 统一内存 · 546GB/s）): Total Memory 128 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **104 GB** | Bandwidth: 546 GB/s — Flagship local workstation: runs 70B Q8_0 at 64K context or multi-agent concurrent pipelines.
- **MacBook Pro M5 Max (128GB Unified · 614GB/s)** (MacBook Pro M5 Max（128GB 统一内存 · 614GB/s）): Total Memory 128 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **108 GB** | Bandwidth: 614 GB/s — 614 GB/s unified memory + Metal 4 GPU Neural Accelerators (3.4x faster prefill on 32K–64K context vs M4 Max).
- **Mac Studio M3 Ultra (256GB Unified · 819GB/s)** (Mac Studio M3 Ultra（256GB 统一内存 · 819GB/s）): Total Memory 256 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **224 GB** | Bandwidth: 819 GB/s — 819 GB/s UltraFusion bus; runs Qwen3-235B-A22B MoE (Q4_K_M / MLX 4-bit) at 28–35 tok/s with 64K context.
- **Mac Studio M3 Ultra (512GB Unified · 819GB/s)** (Mac Studio M3 Ultra（512GB 统一内存 · 819GB/s）): Total Memory 512 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **475 GB** | Bandwidth: 819 GB/s — With sysctl iogpu.wired_limit_mb=486400, loads full DeepSeek-R1-671B (4-bit MLX / Q4_K_M) in a single <195W box at 13–18 tok/s.
- **NVIDIA GPU (8GB VRAM · RTX 4060/3070)** (NVIDIA 独显（8GB 显存 · RTX 4060/3070）): Total Memory 8 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **7.1 GB** | Bandwidth: 272 GB/s — Fast for 7B/8B Q4_K_M at 8K context, but spills layers to system RAM if context is raised to 32K.
- **NVIDIA GPU (12GB VRAM · RTX 4070/3060)** (NVIDIA 独显（12GB 显存 · RTX 4070/3060）): Total Memory 12 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **10.9 GB** | Bandwidth: 504 GB/s — Great for 8B Q8_0 or 14B Q4_K_M (with 4K–8K context and Q8_0 KV cache).
- **Intel Arc B580 (12GB GDDR6 · 456GB/s)** (Intel Arc B580（12GB GDDR6 显存 · 456GB/s）): Total Memory 12 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **10.6 GB** | Bandwidth: 456 GB/s — Budget 12GB Xe2 Battlemage card; runs Qwen3-8B / Gemma-3-12B via SYCL/Vulkan at 38–55 tok/s.
- **NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti (16GB GDDR7 · 448GB/s)** (NVIDIA RTX 5060 Ti（16GB GDDR7 显存 · 448GB/s）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **14.8 GB** | Bandwidth: 448 GB/s — 180W Blackwell (sm_120) sweet-spot card with native FP4 Tensor Cores; runs 14B Q4_K_M / MXFP4 with 32K context.
- **NVIDIA GPU (16GB VRAM · RTX 4060Ti/4080/5070Ti)** (NVIDIA 独显（16GB 显存 · RTX 4060Ti/4080/5070Ti）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **14.8 GB** | Bandwidth: 550 GB/s — Runs 14B Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M at full GPU speed with 16K–32K context.
- **AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT (16GB RDNA 4 · 640GB/s)** (AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT（16GB RDNA 4 · 640GB/s）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **14.6 GB** | Bandwidth: 640 GB/s — RDNA 4 (gfx1201) with 640 GB/s bus; outperforms 128-bit 16GB cards on 14B decode via ROCm 6.3.4 or Vulkan.
- **NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti (16GB GDDR7 · 896GB/s)** (NVIDIA RTX 5070 Ti（16GB GDDR7 显存 · 896GB/s）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **14.8 GB** | Bandwidth: 896 GB/s — 256-bit GDDR7 (896 GB/s = 2.0x RTX 5060 Ti bandwidth); achieves ~93% of RTX 5080 token generation speed on 8B–14B models.
- **NVIDIA RTX 5080 (16GB GDDR7 · 960GB/s)** (NVIDIA RTX 5080（16GB GDDR7 显存 · 960GB/s）): Total Memory 16 GB | Safe Usable Ceiling: **14.8 GB** | Bandwidth: 960 GB/s — 30 Gbps GDDR7 (960 GB/s); fastest single-stream 16GB card (135+ tok/s on 8B Q4_K_M and 64+ tok/s on 14B Q4_K_M).
