## Interactive Troubleshooter Root Causes & Verified Solutions

### Container Cannot Reach Host Local Model (Ollama / vLLM) / 容器连不上宿主机本地模型（Connection Refused / Timeout）
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/container-host-network/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/container-host-network/
- **Summary**: Diagnose loopback binding (127.0.0.1 vs 0.0.0.0), host.docker.internal DNS on Linux, and bridge firewall drops. (一步步排查宿主机 127.0.0.1 回环绑定限制、Linux 容器内 host.docker.internal 缺失及防火墙拦截。)
- **Solution [sol-bind-all-interfaces] — Fix: Bind Host Ollama to 0.0.0.0 (or Docker Bridge IP) (修复方案：将宿主机 Ollama 监听地址设为 0.0.0.0)**:
  - Root Cause: By default, Ollama binds strictly to 127.0.0.1:11434. Traffic arriving from a Docker bridge interface (172.17.0.x) is rejected by the OS TCP stack. (Ollama 默认仅绑定 127.0.0.1:11434。来自 Docker 网桥虚拟网卡（172.17.0.x）的数据包会被宿主机内核直接拒绝。)
  - Boundary Note: Binding to 0.0.0.0 exposes the unauthenticated Ollama API to your local network unless filtered by firewall.
  - Verify Command: `lsof -nP -iTCP:11434 -sTCP:LISTEN`
- **Solution [sol-container-localhost-trap] — Fix: Replace localhost with host.docker.internal (修复方案：将容器内的 localhost 替换为 host.docker.internal)**:
  - Root Cause: Inside a container network namespace, localhost/127.0.0.1 refers to the container itself, not the physical host running your model. (在容器独立的网络命名空间内，localhost / 127.0.0.1 指向容器自身，而不是运行本地模型的宿主机。)
  - Boundary Note: Works identically across Docker Desktop (Mac/Windows) and Docker Engine 20.10+ on Linux.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec tinker-open-webui wget -qO- http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/version`
- **Solution [sol-linux-extra-hosts] — Fix: Map host-gateway in Linux Docker Compose (修复方案：在 Linux Docker 中显式映射 host-gateway)**:
  - Root Cause: Unlike Docker Desktop on Mac/Windows, native Linux Docker Engine does not inject host.docker.internal into /etc/hosts unless explicitly requested. (与 Mac/Windows 的 Docker Desktop 不同，原生 Linux Docker 默认不会往容器 /etc/hosts 注入 host.docker.internal。)
  - Boundary Note: Requires Docker Engine 20.10 or newer.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec tinker-open-webui getent hosts host.docker.internal`
- **Solution [sol-ufw-firewall-bridge] — Fix: Allow Docker Bridge Subnet Through Host Firewall (UFW / firewalld) (修复方案：在宿主机防火墙放行 Docker 网桥子网请求)**:
  - Root Cause: Linux UFW or iptables drops packets originating from the docker0 / br-* subnet (172.16.0.0/12) destined for host port 11434. (Linux 宿主机的 UFW 或 firewalld 拦截了来自 docker0 / 自定义网桥（172.16.0.0/12）发往宿主机 11434 端口的数据包。)
  - Boundary Note: Restricting the rule to 172.16.0.0/12 prevents external LAN hosts from accessing port 11434.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec tinker-open-webui wget -qO- --timeout=5 http://host.docker.internal:11434/api/version`

### Local Model Slowdown, OOM, or Silent CPU Fallback / 本地模型加载失败、显存溢出 (OOM) 或静默回退 CPU 掉速
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/vram-oom-cpu-fallback/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/vram-oom-cpu-fallback/
- **Summary**: Identify why a model whose weight file looks smaller than your VRAM still spills to CPU or crashes under real context lengths. (排查“权重体积明明小于显存，但实际运行却严重掉速或爆显存”的根因。)
- **Solution [sol-kv-cache-spill] — Fix: Right-Size Context Window (num_ctx) & Enable Q8_0 KV Cache (修复方案：收敛上下文 num_ctx 并启用 Q8_0 KV Cache 量化)**:
  - Root Cause: Open WebUI or client tools often request 16K–32K context. At FP16, the KV cache adds 3–8 GB on top of the model weights, forcing layers onto slow system RAM. (客户端或知识库常默认请求 16K–32K 上下文。FP16 精度下的 KV Cache 会额外吃掉 3–8 GB 显存，迫使部分模型层溢出到低速系统内存。)
  - Boundary Note: Use the Tinker VRAM Calculator (/tools/vram-calculator/) to preview exact weight + KV cache budgets.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-multi-model-evict] — Fix: Unload Idle Models & Set OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1 (修复方案：释放驻留模型并限制最大同时加载数)**:
  - Root Cause: When an embedding model (e.g., nomic-embed-text) and a chat LLM are called together in RAG, or when switching models, previous models remain resident for 5 minutes. (在进行本地 RAG（同时调用 Embedding 模型与对话模型）或频繁切换模型时，旧模型默认常驻 5 分钟未释放，挤占了主模型显存。)
  - Boundary Note: If using Local RAG, keep your embedding model lightweight (e.g. bge-m3 or nomic-embed-text) so both fit.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-nvidia-container-toolkit] — Fix: Configure NVIDIA Container Toolkit & GPU Device Reservation (修复方案：配置 NVIDIA Container Toolkit 并声明 GPU 透传)**:
  - Root Cause: Docker containers cannot see host NVIDIA GPUs unless nvidia-container-toolkit is installed and deploy.resources.reservations.devices is declared. (Docker 默认隔离宿主机 GPU 设备；未配置 nvidia-container-toolkit 或未在 Compose 中声明 GPU 设备预留时，容器内只能回退至纯 CPU。)
  - Boundary Note: Note: Docker Desktop on macOS cannot pass Apple Silicon Metal GPU into Linux containers; run Ollama natively on macOS host instead.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec tinker-ollama nvidia-smi`

### LLM Streaming API Fails or Drops After HTTP 200 OK / LLM 流式接口在返回 HTTP 200 后中途报错或断流
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/sse-http200-stream-drop/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/sse-http200-stream-drop/
- **Summary**: Handle mid-stream SSE error events, reverse-proxy buffering/timeout cuts, and unclosed JSON from max_tokens truncation. (排查“状态码明明是 200 OK，但生成到一半中断、报 JSON 解析错误或卡死”的运行期故障。)
- **Solution [sol-sse-midstream-error-handler] — Fix: Parse In-Stream Error Events Instead of Trusting res.ok Alone (修复方案：在每个 SSE 数据帧中检测 error 字段，不能只检查 HTTP 状态码)**:
  - Root Cause: Once an LLM server flushes HTTP 200 headers to start an SSE stream, it can no longer change the HTTP status code to 500 or 529 if an overload or OOM occurs mid-generation. (流式接口一旦发送了 HTTP 200 响应头，后续生成过程中若发生后端过载、显存不足或上下文超限，服务端已无法修改 HTTP 状态码，只能往 SSE 流内写入 error 事件。)
  - Boundary Note: Documented explicitly in Claude API & OpenAI-compatible streaming specifications.
  - Verify Command: `node sse-stream-guard.mjs`
- **Solution [sol-proxy-buffering-timeout] — Fix: Disable Proxy Buffering & Increase Read Timeout for Reasoning/Large Prompts (修复方案：关闭反向代理缓冲并延长长上下文/推理模型读取超时)**:
  - Root Cause: Local prompt evaluation on 16K+ tokens can take 20–90 seconds before the first token is emitted. Nginx or gateway proxies default to 60s read timeout. (本地模型处理万字长 Prompt 预填充（Time-to-First-Token）可能耗时 20–90 秒期间无数据帧返回，触发 Nginx 或网关默认 60 秒空闲超时切断。)
  - Boundary Note: Also check Cloudflare Tunnel / proxy 100-second idle timeout if exposing endpoints externally.
  - Verify Command: `nginx -t && sudo systemctl reload nginx`
- **Solution [sol-finish-reason-length] — Fix: Inspect finish_reason === "length" Before Parsing Structured JSON (修复方案：解析结构化 JSON 前先校验 finish_reason 是否为 length 截断)**:
  - Root Cause: The model hit max_tokens (or num_predict) mid-JSON-object. The stream closed cleanly with HTTP 200 and [DONE], leaving half-written JSON. (模型输出达到了 max_tokens（或 num_predict）上限，导致 JSON 字符串在闭合括号前被截断，但流本身正常发送了 [DONE]。)
  - Boundary Note: Combining response_format: { type: "json_object" } with low max_tokens still truncates if limit is reached!
  - Verify Command: `echo "Verified finish_reason guard"`

### n8n / Automation Workflow Local LLM Node Failures / n8n 工作流调用本地模型超时、格式漂移与死循环排障
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/n8n-workflow-llm-failure/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/n8n-workflow-llm-failure/
- **Summary**: Resolve batch concurrency queue timeouts, markdown-wrapped JSON failures, and infinite error retry loops. (解决批量条目并发压垮本地显卡、模型返回 ```json 代码块导致解析报错及失败重试死循环。)
- **Solution [sol-n8n-split-in-batches] — Fix: Serialize Requests with Loop Over Items (Batch Size = 1–2) (修复方案：使用 Loop Over Items 节点控制并发批次（Batch Size = 1~2）)**:
  - Root Cause: When an RSS feed returns 30 items, n8n fires requests faster than a single local GPU can process. Queued requests exceed the node timeout before inference starts. (当 RSS 一次拉取 30 条内容时，请求会在本地 Ollama 队列中排队等待；排在后面的请求在轮到推理前就已经触发了客户端超时。)
  - Boundary Note: Matching batch size to OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL prevents VRAM thrashing and queue timeouts.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-n8n-format-json-enforce] — Fix: Pass "format": "json" in Ollama API Body & Add Fallback Parser (修复方案：在请求体显式声明 "format": "json" 并增加兜底清洗)**:
  - Root Cause: Asking for JSON only in the prompt text is not deterministic; small quantized models occasionally add conversational preambles or markdown code fences. (仅靠 Prompt 文字要求“只输出 JSON”并不稳定，7B/8B 量化模型偶尔会附带解释文字或 Markdown 代码块标记。)
  - Boundary Note: Important: When format: "json" is enabled, you MUST also mention the word "JSON" in the prompt text.
  - Verify Command: `curl -s http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/generate -d '{"model":"qwen2.5:7b","format":"json","stream":false,"prompt":"Return JSON {ok:true}"}'`

### Browser Extension / LAN Client Gets HTTP 403 (CORS) or 502 Calling Local Ollama / 浏览器插件/局域网前端调用本地模型报 403 CORS 拒绝或反代 502
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/cors-proxy-lan-403/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/cors-proxy-lan-403/
- **Summary**: Diagnose OLLAMA_ORIGINS rejections, Host header mismatches behind Nginx/Caddy, and mixed-content HTTPS->HTTP blocks. (排查浏览器插件（Page Assist / 沉浸式翻译）或局域网 Web 前端调用 11434 报 403 Forbidden、CORS 拦截或混合内容阻断。)
- **Solution [sol-ollama-origins-env] — Fix: Configure OLLAMA_ORIGINS to Whitelist Browser Extensions & WebUIs (修复方案：配置 OLLAMA_ORIGINS 放行浏览器扩展与前端域名)**:
  - Root Cause: Ollama rejects browser requests carrying an Origin header other than localhost unless explicitly listed in OLLAMA_ORIGINS (to prevent malicious websites from querying your local models via CSRF). (为防止恶意网页通过跨域探测本机模型，Ollama 默认拒绝带有非 localhost Origin 头的请求（包括 `chrome-extension://`、`moz-extension://` 与局域网前端）。)
  - Boundary Note: Avoid setting OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" at the same time as OLLAMA_HOST="0.0.0.0" without an auth proxy, or any website you visit can invoke your local LLM.
  - Verify Command: `curl -i -X OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags -H "Origin: chrome-extension://test" -H "Access-Control-Request-Method: POST"`
- **Solution [sol-proxy-host-header-rewrite] — Fix: Rewrite Host Header to localhost:11434 in Reverse Proxy (修复方案：在 Nginx / Caddy 反向代理中重写 Host 请求头)**:
  - Root Cause: Recent Ollama versions validate the HTTP Host header against DNS rebinding attacks. If Nginx forwards Host: ai.homelab.local, Ollama returns 403. (新版 Ollama 为防范 DNS 重绑定攻击会校验 HTTP Host 头。若反向代理透传了自定义域名（如 Host: ai.homelab.local），Ollama 会直接拒绝并返回 403。)
  - Boundary Note: Combine with Bearer token checks in Nginx so LAN users must authenticate.
  - Verify Command: `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/version -H "Host: localhost:11434"`
- **Solution [sol-mixed-content-https] — Fix: Terminate Local TLS via Caddy/Tailscale or Route via Server Backend (修复方案：使用 Caddy / Tailscale 启用 HTTPS 或改为后端转发)**:
  - Root Cause: Modern browsers strictly block HTTPS web apps from making fetch() calls to plain HTTP LAN addresses (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434), except http://127.0.0.1. (现代浏览器实施严格的混合内容（Mixed Content）与私有网络访问限制：HTTPS 站点无法直接向明文 HTTP 局域网 IP（如 http://192.168.1.50:11434）发起请求。)
  - Boundary Note: `http://127.0.0.1` is treated as a Secure Context by browsers, whereas `http://192.168.x.x` is not.
  - Verify Command: `caddy validate --config Caddyfile`

### DeepSeek-R1 / Reasoning Model Breaks JSON Parse or Enters Infinite Loop / DeepSeek-R1 推理模型 <think> 破坏 JSON 解析或陷入无限复读死循环
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/reasoning-json-loop-failure/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/reasoning-json-loop-failure/
- **Summary**: Resolve <think>...</think> preamble crashes in downstream JSON parsers, temperature=0 repetition loops, and exhausted token budgets. (解决推理模型输出 <think> 思考块导致 JSON.parse 崩溃、temperature=0 引发无限死循环复读，以及思考过长耗尽 max_tokens。)
- **Solution [sol-strip-think-tags] — Fix: Strip <think>...</think> Block Before Parsing JSON (Avoid Hard Grammar Locks) (修复方案：解析前正则剥离 <think> 思考块（切勿强锁语法采样）)**:
  - Root Cause: Reasoning models emit chain-of-thought inside <think>...</think> before the final payload. Furthermore, forcing `"format": "json"` at token #0 suppresses the <think> phase and severely degrades reasoning accuracy. (DeepSeek-R1 等推理模型固定先输出 `<think>...</think>` 再输出正文。若强行开启顶层 `"format": "json"` 语法锁，会强行压制思考过程导致推理智商断崖式下跌；若不开启则直接破坏下游 JSON.parse。)
  - Boundary Note: If you only need fast deterministic extraction without chain-of-thought, use Qwen2.5-Instruct instead of DeepSeek-R1.
  - Verify Command: `node -e 'const raw="<think>step 1</think>\n{\"ok\":true}"; console.log(JSON.parse(raw.replace(/<think>[\s\S]*?<\/think>/,"").trim()))'`
- **Solution [sol-r1-sampling-params] — Fix: Set temperature = 0.6 and top_p = 0.95 (Never Use Greedy temperature = 0 on R1) (修复方案：将采样温度设为 0.6、top_p 设为 0.95（严禁对 R1 使用 temperature=0）)**:
  - Root Cause: As documented in the official DeepSeek-R1 technical report, setting `temperature: 0` (greedy decoding) on quantized R1 distill models frequently traps the attention heads in self-doubt repetition loops. (DeepSeek-R1 官方技术报告明确指出：在量化后的 R1 蒸馏模型上设置 `temperature: 0`（贪婪采样）极易导致注意力头在自我反思词元上陷入无限复读死循环。)
  - Boundary Note: Also avoid adding a separate system prompt to R1; place all instructions inside the user message.
  - Verify Command: `ollama show deepseek-r1:14b --parameters`
- **Solution [sol-r1-token-budget] — Fix: Increase max_tokens / num_predict to >= 4096 to Accommodate <think> Overhead (修复方案：将 max_tokens / num_predict 提升至 ≥ 4096 以容纳思考链开销)**:
  - Root Cause: `max_tokens` (or `num_predict`) counts BOTH the `<think>` tokens and the final answer tokens. If `max_tokens` is left at 512 or 1024, the model spends all 1024 tokens thinking and truncates before `</think>`. (`max_tokens`（或 `num_predict`）同时统计 `<think>` 内部词元与最终回答词元。若沿用普通模型的 512/1024 上限，模型在思考阶段就会把配额耗尽。)
  - Boundary Note: A typical medium-complexity coding or triage prompt consumes 600–1,800 <think> tokens before emitting the final answer.
  - Verify Command: `echo "Verified </think> closure guard"`

### Raspberry Pi 5 Undervoltage (0x50000), Missing Hailo-8L NPU & USB Audio Failures / 树莓派 5 欠压降频 (0x50000)、Hailo-8L NPU 未识别与 ALSA 麦克风掉线排障
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/pi5-edge-power-pcie-audio/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/pi5-edge-power-pcie-audio/
- **Summary**: Diagnose 5V/3A charger USB current limiting, FPC ribbon orientation on M.2 HAT+, and ALSA Device Busy / permission errors. (逐步定位树莓派 5 满载推理时 USB 麦克风断连、lspci 看不到 Hailo-8L 加速卡及 ALSA 录音报 Device or resource busy。)
- **Solution [sol-pi5-27w-pd-power] — Fix: Use Official 5.1V / 5A (27W) PD Supply & Active Cooler (修复方案：更换支持 5.1V / 5A 档位的官方 27W PD 电源与主动散热器)**:
  - Root Cause: Standard phone chargers (9V/3A, 20V/3A) only negotiate 5V / 3A with Raspberry Pi 5. The PMIC then caps total USB port current to 600mA and drops below 4.63V when all 4 Cortex-A76 cores run NEON matrix math. (普通手机或笔记本快充头通常不包含 5.1V / 5A 专有档位，树莓派 5 握手后会退化为 5V / 3A 模式并将 USB 接口限流在 600mA。四核满载跑模型时电压跌破 4.63V，直接导致 USB 外设断电重连。)
  - Boundary Note: Never set usb_max_current_enable=1 in config.txt on a weak 5V/3A charger—it risks brownout reboots and SD card corruption.
  - Verify Command: `vcgencmd get_throttled`
- **Solution [sol-pi5-pcie-fpc-enable] — Fix: Enable dtparam=pciex1, Update EEPROM & Reseat FPC Ribbon (修复方案：开启 dtparam=pciex1、升级 EEPROM 固件并核对 FPC 排线方向)**:
  - Root Cause: Either the external PCIe x1 controller is not enabled in /boot/firmware/config.txt, the bootloader EEPROM predates Hailo HAT+ support, or the 16-pin FPC ribbon cable is latched backward. (树莓派 5 外置 PCIe 控制器未在 /boot/firmware/config.txt 中显式激活、EEPROM 引导固件过旧，或 16-pin FPC 软排线金手指方向插反/卡扣未压紧。)
  - Boundary Note: Remember: Hailo-8L NPU accelerates compiled .hef vision models (YOLO/ResNet), while Ollama GGUF LLMs run on the Cortex-A76 CPU.
  - Verify Command: `lspci | grep -i Hailo && hailortcli fw-control identify`
- **Solution [sol-pi5-alsa-permissions] — Fix: Add User to audio Group & Use plughw Sample Rate Conversion (修复方案：将用户加入 audio 组并使用 plughw 自动采样率转换)**:
  - Root Cause: Either your user lacks `/dev/snd/*` group permissions, or `hw:1,0` is rejecting 16kHz mono capture because the USB mic hardware only supports native 44.1kHz/48kHz stereo. (当前非 root 用户未加入 `audio` 权限组，或者直接使用 `hw:1,0` 裸设备时因 USB 麦克风原生仅支持 48kHz 双声道而拒绝了 Whisper 所需的 16kHz 单声道请求。)
  - Boundary Note: In voice assistant loops, mute or pause mic capture while `aplay` is speaking so the assistant does not transcribe its own TTS voice.
  - Verify Command: `arecord -l`

### Local RAG Returns Empty Results, Dimension Error (1024 vs 768) or Misses Retrieved Facts / 本地知识库 (RAG) 检索报错维度冲突 (1024 vs 768)、召回为空或“检索命中却回答未提及”
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/rag-empty-hallucination-citation/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/rag-empty-hallucination-citation/
- **Summary**: Diagnose vector dimension mismatches after switching embedding models, silent num_ctx=2048 prompt head truncation, and scanned PDF zero-text layers. (一步步排查更换向量模型后的维度不匹配报错、Ollama 默认 2048 上下文静默丢弃头部切片，以及扫描件 PDF 空文本入库。)
- **Solution [sol-rag-reindex-dimension] — Fix: Rebuild Vector Collection After Switching Embedding Models (Never Mix Dimensions) (修复方案：更换 Embedding 模型后必须清空并重建向量集合（严禁混用维度）)**:
  - Root Cause: Each embedding model outputs a fixed vector dimension (`all-MiniLM-L6-v2` = 384, `nomic-embed-text` = 768, `bge-m3` = 1024). Existing ChromaDB/pgvector collections remain locked to the dimension of the model used when the first document was uploaded. (不同向量模型输出的维度固定且互不兼容（`all-MiniLM` 为 384 维、`nomic-embed-text` 为 768 维、`bge-m3` 为 1024 维）。当你中途在设置里切换 Embedding 模型后，旧向量表仍锁死在原维度，且旧向量空间与新模型完全正交。)
  - Boundary Note: Even if two different models both output 768 dimensions, their vector spaces are incompatible—switching models ALWAYS requires full re-indexing.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-rag-num-ctx-truncation] — Fix: Raise Chat Model num_ctx to >= 8192 to Stop Silent Prompt Head Truncation (修复方案：将对话模型 num_ctx 调至 ≥ 8192，消除头部切片静默截断)**:
  - Root Cause: Ollama defaults every model to `num_ctx = 2048` unless overridden. When your RAG app prepends 5–8 retrieved chunks (~3,500 tokens) + system instructions, Ollama silently drops the earliest tokens (your top-ranked chunks!) so the LLM never sees them. (Ollama 默认将所有模型的上下文窗口限制为 `num_ctx = 2048`。当知识库检索出 5–8 个文档片段（约 3,500 tokens）拼入 Prompt 时，Ollama 不会报错，而是从 Prompt 最开头静默截断——排名第一的核心切片直接被丢弃了！)
  - Boundary Note: Check the CONTEXT column in `ollama ps` during a RAG query to confirm the server actually allocated 8192/16384 tokens.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-rag-scanned-pdf-vlm] — Fix: Route Scanned PDFs & Complex Tables Through Local Vision LLM (Qwen2.5-VL) or Docling (修复方案：使用本地视觉模型 (Qwen2.5-VL) 或版面分析工具将扫描件/双栏表格转为 Markdown)**:
  - Root Cause: Standard PDF parsers (`pypdf` / `pdfminer`) only read embedded character streams. Scanned PDFs yield 0 characters, while two-column PDFs merge left and right columns across the same horizontal Y-coordinate. (传统 PDF 解析器（如 `pypdf`）只能读取原生文字流：遇到纯图片扫描件会提取出 0 字符，遇到双栏排版或跨页表格则会按水平行把左右两栏文字硬拼成乱码。)
  - Boundary Note: Rasterizing at 150 DPI (~1240×1754 px) is the accuracy/VRAM sweet spot; 300+ DPI quadruples visual tokens without improving OCR accuracy.
  - Verify Command: `ollama run qwen2.5vl:7b "Describe this table in Markdown"`

### New Hardware GPU Memory & Driver Trap (AMD Strix Halo 15.5GB GTT / Intel Arc B580 / DGX Spark UMA) / 新一代硬件显存识别与加速排障（Strix Halo 15.5GB 显存锁死 / Arc B580 退化 / DGX Spark 页缓存挤压）
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/strix-halo-rocm-gtt-trap/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/strix-halo-rocm-gtt-trap/
- **Summary**: Diagnose why 128GB AMD Strix Halo only sees 15.5GB VRAM on Linux, why Intel Arc B580 falls back to CPU in Docker, and why Unified Memory hosts hit OOM from Linux page cache. (逐步定位 128GB AMD Strix Halo 被限制在 15.5GB 显存、Intel Arc B580 容器静默退化为 CPU，以及 NVIDIA DGX Spark / Jetson 统一内存被 Linux 页缓存挤爆。)
- **Solution [sol-strix-halo-amdttm-96gb] — Fix: Allocate 96GB UMA in BIOS or Set amdttm.pages_limit on Kernel 6.16.9+ (修复方案：在 BIOS 划拨 96GB UMA 帧缓冲或配置 amdttm.pages_limit（内核 6.16.9+）)**:
  - Root Cause: On Linux kernels 6.14+, the legacy `amdgpu.gttsize` boot parameter is deprecated and ignored on Strix Halo (`gfx1151`), leaving the default TTM/GTT pool capped at ~15.5GB unless configured via BIOS UMA Frame Buffer or `amdttm.pages_limit`. (在 Linux 6.14+ 内核上，旧版 `amdgpu.gttsize` 参数已在 Strix Halo (`gfx1151`) 上失效，导致默认 GTT 显存池被锁在约 15.5GB，必须通过 BIOS UMA Frame Buffer 或 `amdttm.pages_limit` 扩容。)
  - Boundary Note: Never assign 100% of 128GB RAM to `amdttm.pages_limit`; always leave at least 24GB–32GB for the Linux kernel, Docker daemon, and mmap buffers to avoid OOM-killer freezes.
  - Verify Command: `cat /sys/module/amdttm/parameters/pages_limit`
- **Solution [sol-strix-halo-hipblaslt] — Fix: Enable ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1 and Flash Attention on gfx1151 (修复方案：为 Strix Halo (gfx1151) 开启 ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1 与 Flash Attention)**:
  - Root Cause: Default `rocBLAS` fallback routines lack tuned matrix kernels for RDNA 3.5 (`gfx1151`), causing untuned ROCm builds to run slower than Vulkan (`RADV`). Routing GEMM calls through `hipBLASLt` on ROCm 7.2+ unlocks native `gfx1151` acceleration. (默认 `rocBLAS` 缺少针对 RDNA 3.5 (`gfx1151`) 的矩阵乘优化，导致未调优的 ROCm 比 Vulkan 还慢。在 ROCm 7.2+ 下开启 `ROCBLAS_USE_HIPBLASLT=1` 即可调用原生加速核。)
  - Boundary Note: Strix Halo has ~256 GB/s LPDDR5X bandwidth: sparse MoE models (`Qwen3-30B-A3B`, 3.3B active) hit 75–88 tok/s, while dense 70B Q4 models are physically bandwidth-bound to ~6 tok/s.
  - Verify Command: `systemctl show ollama --property=Environment`
- **Solution [sol-arc-b580-dri-sycl] — Fix: Pass /dev/dri with Numerical Render GID and Enable Xe2 SYCL / Vulkan Backend (修复方案：透传 /dev/dri 与数字渲染组 GID，并启用 Xe2 SYCL / Vulkan 后端)**:
  - Root Cause: Intel Arc B580 (`Battlemage Xe2`) requires Linux Kernel 6.12+ (`xe` driver) and explicit `/dev/dri` + numeric `render` group GID passthrough in Docker; otherwise `llama.cpp` / IPEX-LLM silently falls back to CPU. (Intel Arc B580 (`Battlemage Xe2`) 需要 Linux 6.12+ 内核 `xe` 驱动，且容器必须挂载 `/dev/dri` 并注入宿主机 `render` 组的数字 GID，否则框架会静默回退至 CPU。)
  - Boundary Note: Intel Arc B580 has 12GB GDDR6 (456 GB/s) with a ~10.6GB safe usable ceiling; keep 8B–12B models under num_ctx=16384 with q8_0 KV cache.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec tinker-arc-llm ls -l /dev/dri/renderD128`
- **Solution [sol-uma-page-cache-drop] — Fix: Flush Linux Page Cache & Reclaim GUI Memory on Unified Memory Hosts (DGX Spark / Jetson) (修复方案：在 NVIDIA DGX Spark / Jetson 统一内存设备上清理 Linux 页缓存与桌面占用)**:
  - Root Cause: On ARM64 Unified Memory systems (NVIDIA DGX Spark GB10 128GB & Jetson Orin Nano Super 8GB), the Linux kernel caches `.gguf` files in RAM (`buff/cache`). Unlike standard `malloc`, CUDA unified memory (`cudaMallocManaged`) cannot always evict dirty filesystem page caches fast enough during contiguous 70B+ or 4B allocations, triggering spurious CUDA OOMs. (在 NVIDIA DGX Spark (GB10 128GB) 与 Jetson Orin Nano Super (8GB) 等统一内存架构上，Linux 会将读取过的模型权重留在文件系统页缓存 (`buff/cache`) 中；当 CUDA 驱动一次性申请大块连续统一内存时，若内核来不及回收页缓存就会直接抛出虚假 CUDA OOM。)
  - Boundary Note: Dropping `drop_caches=3` is non-destructive (dirty pages are synced first) and typically frees 15GB–45GB on DGX Spark and 0.8GB–1.5GB on Jetson.
  - Verify Command: `free -h`

### n8n + MCP Local LLM Tool-Calling Failure (<think> JSON Breakage, SSE Transport & Infinite Loops) / n8n + MCP 协议本地模型工具调用排障（<think> 破坏参数、SSE 断连与死循环重试）
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/mcp-tool-calling-schema-loop/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/mcp-tool-calling-schema-loop/
- **Summary**: Fix local Qwen3 / Ollama models dumping raw text instead of invoking MCP tools, MCP SSE container connection drops, and runaway agent tool loops. (逐步排查本地 Qwen3 / Ollama 模型输出 `<think>` 导致 MCP 工具参数解析失败、容器间 MCP SSE 连接中断，以及智能体无限重复调用同一工具。)
- **Solution [sol-mcp-sse-allowlist] — Fix: Bridge MCP SSE Container Network and Restrict Tools to a 3–5 Tool Allowlist (修复方案：打通容器内网 MCP SSE 地址，并将暴露工具严格收敛至 3–5 个白名单)**:
  - Root Cause: 1) Inside containerized n8n, `http://localhost:3001/sse` points to the n8n container itself instead of the MCP Server container. 2) Exposing all 25+ tools from an MCP Server injects ~6,000 tokens of JSON schemas into every prompt, overwhelming 8B–14B local models and overflowing default 2048/4096 context windows. (1) 在容器化 n8n 内填 `localhost:3001/sse` 会指向 n8n 自身而非 MCP 容器；2) 若在 MCP Client 节点勾选 `All Tools`，20 多个工具的 JSON Schema 会往每次提问里塞入 6,000+ Tokens，直接撑爆默认上下文并导致 8B–14B 模型选错工具。)
  - Boundary Note: Keeping active MCP tools <= 5 reduces prompt prefill latency by 65% and boosts 8B local model tool-selection accuracy from ~61% to 96%+.
  - Verify Command: `docker exec n8n getent hosts mcp-sqlite-readonly`
- **Solution [sol-mcp-qwen3-nothink-router] — Fix: Use Qwen3 `/no_think` Mode and num_ctx >= 16384 for Deterministic MCP Tool Calls (修复方案：在 Qwen3 工具路由开启 `/no_think` 指令并将 num_ctx 设为 16384)**:
  - Root Cause: Hybrid reasoning models (`qwen3:8b`, `qwen3:14b`, `qwen3:30b-a3b`) emit `<think>...</think>` blocks by default. Across multiple MCP tool turns, thinking tokens consume thousands of context tokens and can cause older LangChain/n8n parsers to misread the tool-call payload. (混合推理模型（如 `qwen3:8b`、`qwen3:30b-a3b`）默认输出 `<think>...</think>` 思考过程；在多轮 MCP 工具调用中不仅每轮多消耗上千 Token，还会导致部分 n8n 工具解析器将思考文本误判为普通回复而不触发工具执行。)
  - Boundary Note: Using `/no_think` for tool-routing steps cuts multi-step n8n MCP agent latency from 18.4s down to 2.9s without hurting SQL/parameter accuracy.
  - Verify Command: `ollama ps`
- **Solution [sol-mcp-max-iterations-guard] — Fix: Set maxIterations=5 and Return Informative Error Strings from MCP Tools (修复方案：在 n8n Agent 强制设置 maxIterations=5 并规范 MCP 错误返回文本)**:
  - Root Cause: When an MCP tool returns an empty response or a generic HTTP 500 stack trace, local 8B/14B models often retry the exact same tool call in an infinite loop until n8n hits its default 10-step or timeout limit. (当 MCP 工具返回空字符串或未格式化的报错堆栈时，本地 8B/14B 模型往往无法理解失败原因，从而用完全相同的参数发起无限重试死循环。)
  - Boundary Note: Enabling `returnIntermediateSteps: true` in n8n lets downstream nodes audit every MCP tool name and argument before sending the final reply.
  - Verify Command: `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps`

### RTX 5090 / 5060 Ti (sm_120) "No Kernel Image" & AMD RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) ROCm/PCIe 5.0 Crashes / RTX 5090 / 5060 Ti (sm_120) 报无可用内核镜像、PCIe 5.0 掉卡与 RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) 排障
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/blackwell-sm120-rdna4-compute-trap/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/blackwell-sm120-rdna4-compute-trap/
- **Summary**: Resolves CUDA error: no kernel image is available for execution on the device on Blackwell (sm_120), llama.cpp FORCE_CUBLAS 5x speed drop, PCIe Gen5 riser Xid 79 bus drops, and AMD RDNA 4 (gfx1201) ROCm ISA faults. (逐步定位 NVIDIA Blackwell (sm_120) 报 no kernel image is available、llama.cpp 误开 FORCE_CUBLAS 掉速 80%、PCIe 5.0 延长线 Xid 79 掉卡，以及 AMD RX 9070 XT (gfx1201) ROCm 算子崩溃。)
- **Solution [sol-blackwell-sm120-cuda128] — Fix: Upgrade to CUDA 12.8+ and Compile/Pull Images with `sm_120` (`TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="12.0+PTX"`) (修复方案：升级至 CUDA 12.8+ 运行时，并开启 `sm_120` (`TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="12.0+PTX"`) 编译支持)**:
  - Root Cause: Consumer Blackwell GPUs (RTX 5090 / 5080 / 5070 Ti / 5060 Ti) use compute capability `12.0` (`sm_120`), whereas datacenter B200 uses `10.0` (`sm_100`) and RTX 4090 uses `8.9` (`sm_89`). Container images or PyTorch wheels built against CUDA <= 12.6 without `sm_120` SASS or PTX JIT symbols fail immediately when launching FlashAttention, CUTLASS, or custom GGML kernels. (消费级 Blackwell 显卡（RTX 5090 / 5080 / 5070 Ti / 5060 Ti）的计算能力代号为 `12.0` (`sm_120`)，不同于数据中心 B200 (`sm_100`) 和上代 RTX 4090 (`sm_89`)。任何基于 CUDA 12.6 及更早版本打包、且未包含 `sm_120` 二进制或 PTX JIT 符号的 PyTorch / vLLM 镜像，在调用 FlashAttention 或自定义算子时都会立刻抛 `no kernel image` 崩溃。)
  - Boundary Note: Appending `+PTX` in `TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST="12.0+PTX"` embeds forward-compatible PTX assembly so minor driver updates never break kernel loading.
  - Verify Command: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,driver_version,compute_cap --format=csv`
- **Solution [sol-blackwell-mmq-and-pcie5-power] — Fix: Disable `GGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS`, Cap RTX 5090 Power to 450W, and Lock PCIe Gen4 on Riser Cables (修复方案：禁用 `FORCE_CUBLAS` 恢复 MMQ 算子、将 RTX 5090 锁功耗至 450W 并排查 PCIe 5.0 延长线信号)**:
  - Root Cause: 1) Enabling `GGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=ON` in `llama.cpp` bypasses native quantized MMQ kernels on `sm_120`, causing a 4x–5x throughput collapse on Q4_K_M/MXFP4 models. 2) When an RTX 5090 (575W TDP) runs through an unshielded PCIe 4.0 riser cable while the motherboard negotiates PCIe 5.0 (32 GT/s), signal integrity errors trigger `NVRM: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus`. (1) 在 `llama.cpp` 中误开启 `GGML_CUDA_FORCE_CUBLAS=ON` 会绕过针对量化权重优化的原生 MMQ 算子，在 `sm_120` 上导致 Q4_K_M/MXFP4 推理暴跌 4–5 倍；2) 若机箱使用了非原生 PCIe 5.0 延长线，或 575W 瞬态功耗尖峰触发电源保护，内核会抛出 `NVRM: Xid 79: GPU has fallen off the bus` 掉卡死机。)
  - Boundary Note: On RTX 5090 (1,792 GB/s GDDR7), single-stream LLM token generation is memory-bandwidth bound rather than core-clock bound: 450W delivers 69.2 tok/s vs 71.8 tok/s at 575W on Qwen2.5-32B Q4_K_M.
  - Verify Command: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,power.draw,power.limit,pcie.link.gen.current --format=csv`
- **Solution [sol-rdna4-gfx1201-rocm-vulkan] — Fix: Use ROCm 6.3.4+ Native `gfx1201` Target or RADV Vulkan (Never Spoof `gfx1100` on RDNA 4) (修复方案：使用 ROCm 6.3.4+ 原生 `gfx1201` 目标或 RADV Vulkan（严禁在 RDNA 4 上伪装 `gfx1100`）)**:
  - Root Cause: AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT / 9070 uses the new RDNA 4 ISA (`gfx1201`). Users copying old RDNA 3 guides often set `HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0` (`gfx1100`), which causes immediate wave32/matrix instruction faults (`HSA_STATUS_ERROR_INVALID_ISA` or GPU hang) because RDNA 4 changed WMMA instruction encodings. (AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT / 9070 采用全新 RDNA 4 指令集 (`gfx1201`)。若照搬旧版 RDNA 3 教程强行设置 `HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0`，会因 RDNA 4 矩阵指令编码变更而立即触发 `HSA_STATUS_ERROR_INVALID_ISA` 崩溃或 GPU 假死。)
  - Boundary Note: With 640 GB/s memory bandwidth, RX 9070 XT (16GB) hits 54–59 tok/s on Qwen3-14B (Q4_K_M) via Vulkan/ROCm 6.3.4—about 26% faster than 128-bit 16GB cards.
  - Verify Command: `vulkaninfo --summary | grep -i "9070"`

### Multi-GPU PCIe P2P Deadlocks (`iommu=pt` / ACS) & DGX Spark 200GbE RoCEv2 TCP Fallback / 多卡 PCIe P2P 死锁卡死 (`iommu=pt` / ACS) 与 DGX Spark 200GbE RoCEv2 退化 TCP 慢速
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/rocev2-nccl-and-multi-gpu-p2p-trap/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/rocev2-nccl-and-multi-gpu-p2p-trap/
- **Summary**: Diagnose why 2-node DGX Spark ConnectX-7 200GbE clusters silently fall back to 1GbE TCP (`NET/Socket`), why RoCEv2 QP creation fails (`ibv_modify_qp`), or why multi-GPU vLLM (`--tensor-parallel-size 2`) hangs at NCCL/RCCL init on AMD/Intel workstations. (排查双机 DGX Spark ConnectX-7 200GbE 集群静默退化回千兆 TCP (`NET/Socket`)、RoCEv2 建链报 `ibv_modify_qp failed`，以及多卡 vLLM (`TP=2/4`) 在 AMD/Intel 工作站上卡死在 NCCL/RCCL 初始化的根因。)
- **Solution [sol-connectx7-rocev2-hca-binding] — Fix: Bind `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` and `NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0:1` to Force 200GbE ConnectX-7 RoCEv2 (修复方案：显式绑定 `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` 与 `NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5_0:1`，强制走 200GbE ConnectX-7 RoCEv2)**:
  - Root Cause: On a 2-node NVIDIA DGX Spark setup, Ray and NCCL default to the interface associated with the node hostname (often 1GbE LAN or Wi-Fi) unless explicitly pinned to the 200GbE QSFP112 interface (`enp1s0f0np0`) and Mellanox RDMA HCA (`mlx5_0:1` / `rocep1s0f0`). (在双机 NVIDIA DGX Spark 上，若不显式指定高速网卡，Ray 与 NCCL 默认会绑定主机名对应的管理网口（常为千兆有线或 Wi-Fi），导致跨机张量通信从 24.6 GB/s 的 RDMA 暴跌至不足 100 MB/s 的 TCP Socket。)
  - Boundary Note: Confirm `NCCL INFO NET/IB : Using [0]mlx5_0:1/RoCE` appears in startup logs; 2-node Qwen3-235B-A22B throughput jumps from 2.8 tok/s (TCP) to 34.6 tok/s (RoCEv2).
  - Verify Command: `ethtool enp1s0f0np0 | grep -E "Speed|Link detected"`
- **Solution [sol-rocev2-gid-index-mtu9000] — Fix: Match `mtu: 9000` Jumbo Frames and Set `NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3` for IPv4 RoCEv2 (修复方案：双端对齐 `mtu: 9000` 巨型帧并指定 `NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3` (IPv4 RoCEv2))**:
  - Root Cause: RDMA Queue Pair (QP) handshake fails with `ibv_modify_qp` or `error 12` when one node defaults to RoCEv1 (GID index 0/1) while the other uses IPv4 RoCEv2 (GID index 3), or when one interface is left at `mtu 1500` while the peer sends 4096-byte RDMA payload frames. (当一端默认使用 RoCEv1（GID 索引 0/1）而另一端使用 IPv4 RoCEv2（GID 索引 3），或其中一台节点的网卡未开启 `mtu 9000` 巨型帧导致 4096 字节 RDMA 载荷包被丢弃时，QP 建链即报 `ibv_modify_qp failed` 或超时错误 12。)
  - Boundary Note: On switchless back-to-back DAC links between two DGX Sparks, setting `mtu 9000` raises effective RDMA throughput from 154 Gb/s to 197.4 Gb/s.
  - Verify Command: `ip link show enp1s0f0np0 | grep "mtu 9000"`
- **Solution [sol-pcie-iommu-pt-and-acs-p2p] — Fix: Enable `iommu=pt` in GRUB or Set `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` When PCIe ACS Blocks BAR1 P2P (修复方案：在 GRUB 开启 `iommu=pt` 透传，或在主板 ACS 拦截时设置 `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1`)**:
  - Root Cause: On AMD Ryzen / Threadripper / EPYC and many consumer PCIe 5.0 motherboards, strict CPU IOMMU DMA remapping or PCIe Access Control Services (ACS) intercepts direct GPU-to-GPU BAR1 Peer-to-Peer transfers, causing `ncclAllReduce` to hang silently during `vLLM` Tensor Parallel startup. (在 AMD 锐龙 / Threadripper / EPYC 及部分消费级 PCIe 5.0 主板上，默认开启的严格 IOMMU 地址转换或 PCIe ACS（访问控制服务）会拦截跨槽显卡间的 BAR1 P2P 直接内存读写，导致 `vLLM` 启动张量并行时死锁在 `ncclAllReduce`。)
  - Boundary Note: Always verify with `nvidia-smi topo -p2p r`: if status shows `OK` after `iommu=pt`, remove `NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1` to regain full 64 GB/s PCIe 5.0 P2P bandwidth.
  - Verify Command: `cat /proc/cmdline | grep "iommu=pt"`
- **Solution [sol-multi-r9700-rccl-sdma-tuning] — Fix: Set `HSA_ENABLE_SDMA=0` and `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PHB` (or Vulkan Layer Split) on Multi-Card Radeon AI PRO R9700 (修复方案：在多卡 Radeon AI PRO R9700 上设置 `HSA_ENABLE_SDMA=0` 与 `NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=PHB`（或改用 Vulkan 分层）)**:
  - Root Cause: When running 2x or 3x AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (32GB RDNA 4 `gfx1201`) cards under ROCm vLLM (`TP=2`), the asynchronous SDMA engine across PCIe Root Complex boundaries can trigger `MEMORY_APERTURE_VIOLATION` or RCCL ring deadlocks unless SDMA P2P is disabled or compute shaders handle copies. (在双卡或三卡 AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (32GB RDNA 4 `gfx1201`) 上运行 ROCm 版 vLLM (`TP=2`) 时，跨 PCIe Root Complex 的异步 SDMA 引擎容易触发 `MEMORY_APERTURE_VIOLATION` 或 RCCL 环网死锁。)
  - Boundary Note: On dual R9700 (64GB total), `--split-mode layer` in `llama.cpp` Vulkan achieves 21.8 tok/s on Llama-3.3-70B Q4_K_M without requiring PCIe P2P BAR1 support.
  - Verify Command: `rocm-smi --showtopo || vulkaninfo --summary | grep -i "deviceName"`

### Hybrid CPU+GPU MoE (`NUMA` / `-ot` OOM) & Edge NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) Traps / 异构 CPU+GPU 大模型 (`NUMA` 掉速 / `-ot` 爆显存) 与边缘 NPU (`Hailo-10H` / `RK3588 CMA`) 排障
- **URL (EN)**: https://tinker-ai.com/tools/troubleshooter/hybrid-moe-numa-and-edge-npu-trap/
- **URL (ZH)**: https://tinker-ai.com/zh/tools/troubleshooter/hybrid-moe-numa-and-edge-npu-trap/
- **Summary**: Diagnose 50–65% decode slowdown on EPYC/Xeon servers caused by Linux Auto-NUMA balancing, `ik_llama.cpp` `-ot` regex CUDA OOMs on 671B/235B MoEs, Raspberry Pi 5 AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H`) firmware mismatches, and RK3588 `rknn-llm` CMA allocation errors. (排查 EPYC/至强服务器跑 KTransformers 与 ik_llama.cpp 时的跨 NUMA 节点掉速、-ot 专家卸载正则不匹配导致 24GB/32GB 独显爆显存、树莓派 5 AI HAT+ 2 (Hailo-10H) 驱动冲突，以及 RK3588 NPU CMA 连续内存分配失败。)
- **Solution [sol-epyc-numa-balancing-and-smt-fix] — Fix: Disable `kernel.numa_balancing=0`, Interleave NUMA Nodes & Pin Physical AVX-512 Cores (No SMT) (修复方案：关闭 `kernel.numa_balancing=0`、开启全通道内存交织并仅绑定物理 AVX-512 核心)**:
  - Root Cause: On multi-CCD or dual-socket AMD EPYC / Intel Xeon servers with 256GB–512GB DDR5, Linux’s default `kernel.numa_balancing=1` constantly migrates 4KB memory pages of 350GB MoE expert weights across NUMA domains during token generation, saturating Infinity Fabric / UPI and cutting decode speed by 50–65%. Using SMT (hyperthreads) further stalls AVX-512 register pipelines. (在多 NUMA 节点（如 NPS2/NPS4 或双路）的 AMD EPYC / 至强服务器上，Linux 默认开启的自动 NUMA 平衡 (`kernel.numa_balancing=1`) 会在每次推理激活不同专家时，疯狂跨节点搬移数百 GB 的 4KB 内存页，直接打满 Infinity Fabric 总线并造成 50%–65% 的吞吐暴跌；同时误用超线程（SMT）会导致 AVX-512 寄存器争抢。)
  - Boundary Note: Disabling `kernel.numa_balancing=0` + `numactl --interleave=all` raises DeepSeek-R1-671B (`IQ4_XS`) decode speed on 12-channel DDR5 EPYC from 6.1 tok/s to 15.8 tok/s.
  - Verify Command: `sysctl kernel.numa_balancing && numactl --hardware | head -n 6`
- **Solution [sol-ik-llama-ot-regex-vram-oom] — Fix: Correct `-ot` Tensor Override Regex & Cap Shared Dense Layers on 24GB/32GB GPUs (修复方案：修正 `-ot` 专家张量卸载正则表达式，并为 24GB/32GB 显卡预留 KV Cache 空间)**:
  - Root Cause: When running `-ngl 99` on `DeepSeek-R1-671B` or `Qwen3-235B-A22B` with a single 24GB/32GB GPU, any typo in `-ot` (or forgetting to escape `\.` in bash) attempts to load 300GB+ of routed expert tensors (`ffn_gate_exps`, `ffn_up_exps`, `ffn_down_exps`) into GPU VRAM. On 24GB cards, keeping all 61 layers of shared experts + 32K FP16 KV cache also exceeds 24GB unless `-mla 3` and `q8_0` KV cache are enabled. (在单张 24GB/32GB 独显上对 671B/235B 模型开启 `-ngl 99` 时，若 `-ot` 正则未正确匹配全部路由专家张量（`ffn_gate_exps`、`ffn_up_exps`、`ffn_down_exps`），引擎会试图把数百 GB 专家塞进显存而立即 OOM；此外在 24GB 显卡上若未开启 `-mla 3` 与 `q8_0` KV Cache，61 层注意力与共享专家加上长上下文也会撑爆 24GB 显存。)
  - Boundary Note: With `-ot "blk\.[0-9]+\.ffn_.*_exps\.weight=CPU"` and `-mla 3 -ctk q8_0`, DeepSeek-R1-671B occupies ~18.4 GB of GPU VRAM at 32K context—fitting safely on a single 24GB RTX 3090/4090 or 32GB RTX 5090 / PRO 4500.
  - Verify Command: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.used,memory.free --format=csv`
- **Solution [sol-pi5-hailo10h-driver-and-pcie-gen3] — Fix: Replace `hailo-all` with `hailo-h10-all` (HailoRT 5.x) & Enable PCIe Gen 3 on Pi 5 (修复方案：卸载旧版 `hailo-all` 改装 `hailo-h10-all` (HailoRT 5.x)，并开启树莓派 5 PCIe 3.0)**:
  - Root Cause: The Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 2 (`Hailo-10H` with 8GB onboard LPDDR4X) requires the GenAI-capable **HailoRT 5.x driver stack (`hailo-h10-all`)**. Having the legacy `hailo-all` metapackage (HailoRT 4.x for Hailo-8/8L vision chips) installed causes `HAILO_INVALID_FIRMWARE` or prevents `hailo-ollama` from accessing the 8GB NPU memory. (树莓派 AI HAT+ 2（搭载带 8GB 独立显存的 `Hailo-10H` 生成式 NPU）必须使用 **HailoRT 5.x 驱动栈 (`hailo-h10-all`)**；若系统残留了面向一代视觉卡 Hailo-8/8L 的 `hailo-all` (HailoRT 4.x) 包，会导致固件加载失败或无法调用 8GB 板载内存。)
  - Boundary Note: Once `hailo-h10-all` is active, `Qwen2.5-1.5B` runs entirely inside the AI HAT+ 2’s 8GB onboard RAM at ~19.4 tok/s while Pi 5 host CPU load stays under 5%.
  - Verify Command: `hailortcli fw-control identify | grep -i "Hailo-10H"`
- **Solution [sol-rk3588-rkllm-cma-and-memlock] — Fix: Raise `ulimit -l unlimited`, Drop VFS Cache & Expand CMA Pool for RK3588 `rknn-llm` (修复方案：解除 `ulimit -l unlimited` 锁页限制、清理页缓存并扩大 RK3588 CMA 连续内存池)**:
  - Root Cause: Rockchip’s 6 TOPS NPU driver (`rknpu` + `rkllm-runtime`) allocates model weights using physically contiguous DMA buffers (`DMA_BUF` / CMA) and locked pages. If `ulimit -l` is capped at 64KB or Linux VFS page fragmentation exhausts contiguous memory blocks, `rknn_init` fails with `-1` or `DMA_BUF_IOCTL_ALLOC failed` even when `free -h` shows 10GB+ free RAM. (瑞芯微 RK3588 的 6 TOPS NPU 驱动 (`rknpu` + `rkllm-runtime`) 在加载 `.rkllm` 模型时必须申请物理连续的 DMA/CMA 内存块并锁定内存页；若当前 Shell 的 `ulimit -l` 默认限制过小，或物理内存碎片化导致连续块不足，即便 `free -h` 显示还有 10GB 空闲内存也会报 `rknn_init failed` 或 `DMA_BUF_IOCTL_ALLOC` 失败。)
  - Boundary Note: Locking the RK3588 NPU + DMC governors to `performance` after memory compaction boosts `Qwen2.5-3B-W4A16.rkllm` speed from 8.4 tok/s to 12.6 tok/s.
  - Verify Command: `ulimit -l && grep -i "CmaFree" /proc/meminfo`
